title: Insurance – Domain Consultant
description:
**About The Role**
As an Insurance Domain Expert, you will make an impact by driving business development across our insurance advisory and technology practice — engaging life insurers, general insurers, reinsurers, insurance brokers, and InsurTech players to develop and close strategic engagements. As a trusted advisor, you will shape CX-CRM solutions across underwriting, claims, distribution, actuarial, and regulatory domains, and build long-term relationships at the C-suite and functional leadership levels, bringing deep insurance domain expertise to every pursuit. You will be a valued member of the Cognizant Moment (Business Development) team and work collaboratively with delivery, technology, and account teams, as well as senior client stakeholders across the insurance industry.
  
  
**In this role, you will**

* Serve as the primary domain authority on insurance products, processes, and regulations across Life & Annuities, P&C, Health & Group Benefits, Commercial & Specialty Lines, Reinsurance, and Distribution & Claims, and co-create tailored solutions spanning core system modernisation, distribution analytics, fraud detection, and regulatory compliance.
* Shape and close deals built on platforms such as Salesforce, Adobe, Genesys, and AWS Contact Center, ensuring solutions are designed around policyholder data privacy, suitability, claims-handling, and consent requirements.
* Conduct discovery workshops, As-Is assessments, and strategic roadmap sessions with senior client stakeholders, and deliver senior-level presentations that drive alignment and decisions.
* Act as a trusted advisor through the full client lifecycle — from initial outreach and solution scoping through delivery oversight and account expansion — and represent the firm at IRDAI forums, CII events, industry summits, and InsurTech conferences to strengthen brand visibility and generate qualified leads.
* Contribute to the development of insurance practice offerings, point-of-view papers, and thought leadership content, monitor regulatory developments to translate them into go-to-market opportunities, and mentor junior consultants to support practice growth.

**Work model**
At Cognizant, we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role's business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring 3 days a week in a client or Cognizant office in Bangalore, Chennai, or Hyderabad. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.
  
  
The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you're engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.
  
  
**What You Need To Have To Be Considered**

* 10-15+ years of experience in the insurance industry, with at least 4 years in a business development, pre-sales, or consulting capacity.
* Proven track record of independently winning and managing engagements of INR 3 Cr+ in the insurance sector, with experience working with or selling to life insurers, general insurers, standalone health insurers, or reinsurers.
* Comprehensive knowledge of the insurance value chain: product development, underwriting, policy administration, claims, reinsurance, and distribution.
* Familiarity with insurance compliance and regulatory requirements (KYC/AML, suitability/best-interest, GDPR/CCPA, IRDAI/NAIC/EIOPA-FCA) and how they shape CX & Digital Experience solution design.
* Bachelor's degree in Insurance, Actuarial Science, Finance, Business, or a related field, together with strong executive presence and excellent communication, storytelling, and presentation skills.

**These will help you stand out**

* MBA, FIII/AIII, or ACII designation.
* Hands-on understanding of CX & Digital Experience platforms including Salesforce (Financial Services Cloud / Insurance), Adobe Experience Cloud, Genesys / NICE / AWS Connect, and core insurance systems (Guidewire, Duck Creek, Majesco, FINEOS).
* Proven ability to build C-suite relationships and independently win and manage large-scale, complex insurance engagements.
* Knowledge of Agentic AI & Next-Gen AI Virtual Assistants, hyper-personalisation, unified omnichannel journeys, and consent-based engagement trends in insurance.
* Ability to track regulatory shifts across India (IRDAI), North America (NAIC, OSFI), and Europe/UK (EIOPA, FCA, PRA) and translate them into CX and Digital Experience requirements.

We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

title: Applied AI Architect, Partnerships
description:
**About Anthropic**
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Partners Solutions Architect on the Applied AI team at Anthropic, you will be a Pre-Sales architect focused on cultivating technical relationships with our Global and Regional System Integrators (GSIs/RSIs), and our cloud partners . You will strengthen our relationships with key partners to accelerate indirect revenue, enable their AI practices, and execute on long-term GTM strategy.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Strategic Technical Partnership: Be a technical thought partner to the Anthropic GTM partnerships team, providing technical expertise to better understand the partner landscape, driving key strategic programs, and identifying opportunities to deepen partner technical capabilities. Embed with GSI and cloud partner technical teams to enable their AI practices, support troubleshooting, evangelize Anthropic in their developer communities, and serve as an escalation point for complex technical issues.
* Joint Solution Development: Collaborate with partners to identify high value industry-specific GenAI applications, develop joint solutions and codify reference architectures / best practices to accelerate time to deployment
* Customer Deal Support: Intervene directly to unblock strategic customer deals where partners are the primary delivery vehicle, providing deep technical expertise and solution architecture guidance.
* Partner Ecosystem & Events: Represent Anthropic at partner events such as GSI customer workshops, summits, and industry conferences. Lead or support partner-specific developer events, hackathons, and technical enablement sessions, especially for technically native communities.
* Product Feedback: Validate and gather feedback on Anthropic's products and offerings, especially as they relate to partner use cases and deployment patterns, and deliver this feedback to relevant Anthropic teams to inform product roadmap and partner strategy.

**You May Be a Good Fit If You Have**

* 10+ years of experience in technical customer-facing/partner-facing roles such as Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, Partner Sales Engineer
* Track record of successfully partnering with GSIs and/or cloud providers to solve complex technical challenges, from initial solution design through customer delivery
* Exceptional ability to build relationships with and communicate technical concepts to diverse stakeholders to include C-suite executives, engineering & IT teams, and more
* Strong presentation & technical communication skills with the ability to translate requirements between technical and business stakeholders
* Experience designing scalable cloud architectures and integrating with enterprise systems
* Familiarity with common LLM frameworks and tools or a background in machine learning or data science
* Excitement for engaging in cross-organizational collaboration, working through trade-offs, and balancing competing priorities
* A love of teaching, mentoring, and helping others succeed
* Passion for thinking creatively about how to use technology in a way that is safe and beneficial, and ultimately furthers the goal of advancing safe AI systems

**Logistics**
**Minimum education:**
Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience
  
  
**Required field of study:**
A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience
  
  
**Minimum years of experience:**
Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position
  
  
**Location-based hybrid policy:**
Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.
  
  
**Visa sponsorship:**
We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.
  
  
**We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.**
Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.
  
  
**Your safety matters to us.**
To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.
  
  
**How We're Different**
We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
  
  
The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.
  
  
**Come work with us!**
Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues.
**Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:**
Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

title: GEN AI- SM- AIA
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
Assistant Director – AI / GenAI (Go-To-Market)
  
  
The Data and Analytics team is a multidisciplinary technology team that delivers client projects and solutions across data mining and management, visualization, business analytics, automation, statistical insights, and AI/GenAI. Assignments span a wide range of countries and industry sectors.
  
  
The opportunity
  
  
We are looking for an Assistant Director - AI/GenAI - with a strong Go-To-Market (GTM) focus. The candidate in the role will define and drive the AI GTM strategy, build differentiated solution narratives and value propositions, and develop industry-specific solutions and use cases across Financial Services; Consumer, Products and Retail; Healthcare and Wellness; Manufacturing; Supply Chain; Telecom; Real Estate; and other sectors. A central part of the role is scaling AI/GenAI capabilities through business development, thought leadership, and talent development.
  
  
Your key responsibilities
  
  

* Define and execute the AI/GenAI Go-To-Market (GTM) strategy in alignment with business priorities and identify high-value AI transformation opportunities across functions and industries.
* Drive business development by originating new client opportunities, leading proposal development, and actively participating in pitches for existing and prospective accounts.
* Own executive-level client relationships by serving as a trusted advisor, ensuring delivery excellence, and identifying opportunities to expand client impact.
* Build AI solution narratives, value propositions, and differentiated messaging, and develop industry-specific AI use cases and business cases.
* Develop and commercialize thought leadership on emerging trends, including Generative AI, Agentic AI, autonomous workflows, and AI-powered analytics.
* Build reusable AI/GenAI intellectual property (IP), including proprietary frameworks, accelerators, and new offerings that differentiate EY's capabilities in the market.
* Develop, review, and implement solutions using AI, machine learning, and deep learning, and develop APIs using Python.
* Lead the development and implementation of Generative AI applications using open-source models (Llama, BERT, Mistral, etc.) and closed-source models (OpenAI GPT models, Microsoft Azure Cognitive Services, Claude, Cohere, etc.).
* Design and optimize solutions that leverage vector databases for efficient storage and retrieval of contextual data for LLMs.
* Understand business priorities and sector dynamics, and identify white spaces and opportunities for analytics and AI applications.
* Manage large and mid-sized projects, ensure smooth service delivery across assigned products, engagements and/or geographies, and work with project managers to address resource needs and gaps.
* Coach and mentor managers and junior colleagues, investing in the growth of EY's AI/GenAI talent and team culture.
* Collaborate across D&A and adjacent practices to bring integrated, high-impact AI solutions to clients' most complex challenges, and provide expert review across projects.

Skills and attributes for success
  
  

* AI & Data fluent: Strong understanding of AI, Generative AI, Agentic AI, machine learning, and data and analytics, with the ability to integrate data, AI/GenAI platforms, and analytics into large-scale enterprise transformations and articulate a clear point of view on the evolving agentic AI landscape.
* A proven business developer: Experienced in consulting, solutioning, pre-sales, product strategy, or technology GTM, including managing proposal processes, leading client pitches, growing accounts, and identifying and pursuing new opportunities.
* A leader and collaborator: Energized by managing high-performing cross-functional teams and building trusted, long-term relationships with senior client stakeholders.
* A structured thinker: Able to navigate ambiguity, decompose complex business and technology challenges, and deliver clear, actionable solutions with executive-level communication.
* Ability to translate technical capabilities into measurable business outcomes.
* Ability to work creatively and systematically in a time-limited, problem-solving environment.
* Reliable and ethical, with high professional standards.
* Flexible, curious, and creative, with openness to new ideas and the ability to propose innovative solutions.
* Strong interpersonal skills and a positive, collaborative working style.
* Intercultural intelligence and experience working across multicultural, distributed-delivery teams.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet tight deadlines, and drive projects to completion with minimal supervision.

To qualify for the role, you must have
  
  

* MBA or master's degree in Business, Technology, Data Science, or a related field.
* 11-14 years of relevant work experience in developing and implementing AI and machine learning solutions; deployment experience in Azure is preferred.
* Proven experience in AI transformation programs, with a track record of pipeline generation, proposal development, and deal support.
* Experience building and commercializing AI/GenAI offerings, assets, or IP.
* Exposure to enterprise architecture, data governance, and automation platforms.
* Experience guiding teams on AI/Data Science projects and communicating results to clients.
* Familiarity with implementing solutions in the Azure cloud framework.
* Experience applying statistical techniques such as linear and non-linear regression, classification, optimization, forecasting, and text analytics.
* Familiarity with deep learning and machine learning algorithms and popular AI/ML frameworks.
* Minimum of 6 years of experience working with NLG, LLM, and deep learning techniques, including neural network approaches.
* Expertise in implementing applications using open-source and proprietary LLM models, and proficiency with LangChain-type orchestrators or similar Generative AI workflow management tools.
* Minimum of 6-9 years of programming experience in Python.
* Experience with the software development life cycle (SDLC) and principles of product development.
* Excellent presentation, written, and verbal communication skills.
* Willingness to mentor team members, with strong technical and problem-solving skills.

Ideally, you’ll also have
  
  

* Ability to think strategically and end-to-end, with a result-oriented mindset.
* Ability to build rapport within the firm and earn client trust.
* Willingness to travel extensively and work from client sites and/or practice office locations.

**What We Look For**

title: Principal Architect
description:
**Our Mission**
At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.
  
  
**Who We Are**
In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
  
  
We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
  
  
**Job Summary**
As a Principal Architect you will serve as a trusted executive advisor responsible for influencing our clients’ cybersecurity transformation strategies and driving them to successful security outcomes. This role focuses on enhancing the productivity of field sales teams by delivering business-relevant consulting engagements to strategic prospects and customers. In this senior role you will lead, direct, and advise cross-functional teams to orchestrate strategic, advisory-style client engagements that keep sales campaigns aligned with customer executive priorities.
  
  
Your primary goal is to influence and empower customers to embrace the Palo Alto Networks platform by delivering authoritative architectural roadmaps that create a bridge between the full breadth of Palo Alto Networks’ security solutions and solutions that address the client's business needs.
  
  
**Core Focus Areas**
The Principal Architect is expected to be generally familiar with and conversant in all major security domains, including Secure Access Service Edge/Zero Trust (SASE/ZT), Cloud Security, Security Operations, and Identity Security. The ideal candidate for this role will have deep technical knowledge of and hands-on experience with Network Security (including SASE) and AI Security.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategic Advisory and Client Engagement:**

* Establish and maintain executive-level relationships (Manager, Director, VP, and CxO contacts) in strategic accounts with high growth potential.
* Transform client security strategies by driving conversations that advocate for Palo Alto Networks’ view of transformative Solution Architectures.
* Provide valuable insights and education to clients on effective risk reduction, operational excellence, and cost management.
* Identify and document the client's strategic transformation goals and priority outcomes for value realization, collaborating with specialists to develop business cases around measurable benefits.
* Conduct high-impact consulting engagements, including architectural assessments, designs, and client workshops, setting and driving a strategic agenda with the customer and sales/engineering teams.

title: Power & Utilities Sector Leader
description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**Job Description**
Position Summary (Enter the description) - Power & Utilities Sector Leader responsible for driving sector-led growth through origination, deal shaping, and execution of large-scale transformation programs, with a strong emphasis on strengthening sales enablement and pipeline quality.
  
  
Acts as a senior industry advisor, translating energy transition and utilities disruption into actionable client opportunities while building a differentiated sector proposition and positioning the firm as a partner of choice for complex, high-value engagements.
  
  
**Objective and purpose:**

* Lead the growth agenda for the Power & Utilities sector in GDS, defining strategic priorities, target accounts, and differentiated plays to scale the practice and drive sustained revenue growth.
* Drive origination and closure of large, complex transformation opportunities, translating sector themes such as energy transition, grid modernization, and asset optimization into actionable, high-value deals.
* Act as a trusted advisor to P&U C-suite leaders, shaping enterprise transformation agendas across generation, transmission, distribution, and customer operations with a clear link to business outcomes.
* Institutionalize strong sales enablement across the sector, embedding disciplined pipeline management, pursuit excellence, sector narratives, and commercial frameworks to improve win rates and consistency.
* Build and commercialize differentiated sector offerings, including repeatable frameworks, assets, and go-to-market propositions, while strengthening market positioning through thought leadership and industry engagement.

**Scope of the position:**

* Own the GDS Power & Utilities sector agenda across priority accounts, aligning global client needs with GDS capabilities to identify and shape high-value transformation opportunities across the utilities value chain.
* Lead end-to-end pursuit lifecycle, including opportunity qualification, solution shaping, commercial structuring, and deal closure, ensuring strong integration with onshore teams and global account leadership.
* Drive sales enablement at scale, embedding consistent pipeline discipline, qualification frameworks, reusable sector narratives, and pursuit playbooks to improve win rates and cost of sales efficiency across deals.
* Lead integrated go-to-market initiatives, working across Consulting, SaT, Tax, and Assurance to bring unified, market-facing sector solutions and drive coordinated account penetration.
* Develop and industrialize sector-specific assets and accelerators, including playbooks, benchmarks, and solution components that enable faster deal shaping, repeatable delivery, and differentiated positioning.
* Build and maintain senior client relationships, engaging C-suite stakeholders to position the firm as a strategic partner across energy transition, regulatory change, infrastructure modernization, and customer transformation agendas.
* Build and scale GDS alliance and ecosystem capabilities for the P&U sector, working closely with global teams to operationalize and support partnerships, enhancing solution depth and strengthening competitiveness in large deals
* Build and scale a high-performing P&U capability within GDS, enhancing domain depth, pursuit leadership, and delivery excellence to support sustained sector growth and competitive advantage.

**Essential Functions Of The Job (Enter The Description)**

* Sponsor and steer priority pursuits and engagements, providing senior direction on deal strategy, solution architecture, and executive messaging to maximize win probability and value realization.
* Shape differentiated client propositions, translating complex utilities challenges (e.g., grid resilience, decarbonization, regulatory compliance, asset performance) into clear, outcome-driven transformation narratives for senior stakeholders.
* Govern quality and consistency of proposals and deliverables, ensuring alignment with client priorities, commercial expectations, and delivery feasibility across large, multi-tower programs.
* Drive commercial rigor in deal-making, including pricing strategy, margin management, and contract structuring for complex transformation programs.
* Enable cross-functional solution integration, ensuring seamless alignment of capabilities across consulting, technology, risk, and core utility operations
* Influence executive-level client decision-making, leading high-stakes conversations, facilitating alignment across stakeholders, and positioning transformation initiatives in the context of enterprise value creation.
* Oversee development and evolution of sector IP, ensuring that frameworks, benchmarks, and solution components remain relevant to evolving industry trends and are effectively applied in client contexts
* Ensure strong alignment between deal strategy and delivery approach, guiding teams on shaping scalable, GDS‑led delivery models that are commercially viable, feasible, and differentiated during pursuits.
* Coach and develop senior team members on pursuit leadership and client engagement, strengthening capability in solutioning, storytelling, and executive-level communication.

**Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities (Enter The Description)**

* Evaluate and prioritize pursuit opportunities, applying judgment on deal size, strategic fit, client buying appetite, competitive positioning, and win probability to guide sector focus and resource allocation.
* Make strategic decisions on solution positioning and value definition, determining which transformation levers (e.g., energy transition, grid modernization, cost optimization) to emphasize based on client context and value potential.
* Direct commercial and pricing strategy for complex deals, balancing competitiveness, margin expectations, and delivery feasibility to secure priority opportunities.
* Determine optimal GDS involvement across pursuits, making decisions on when and how to position GDS capabilities within deal constructs, including the choice of delivery model, offshore leverage, and integration with onshore teams to maximize competitiveness and value realization.
* Assess and prioritize sector investments, including development of assets, offerings, and alliance capabilities, based on market demand, pipeline trends, and potential for differentiation.
* Analyze market trends and disruption themes in Power & Utilities, including regulatory shifts, decarbonization priorities, infrastructure investment cycles, and evolving customer models, to inform sector strategy and pursuit direction.

**Education And Experience (Enter The Description)**

* 25+ years of relevant experience in consulting (Big 4 / strategy) and/or senior industry roles within the Power & Utilities sector, with exposure to large-scale transformation or business-led growth initiatives.
* Proven track record of working with global clients and stakeholders, with experience operating across geographies and leading complex, multi-market engagements or pursuits.
* Demonstrated experience in both industry and consulting environments (preferred), bringing a balanced perspective on sector challenges, operating models, and client decision-making dynamics.
* Strong academic background, with an MBA or equivalent advanced degree preferred; undergraduate degree in engineering, business, or a related discipline is typically expected.
* Exposure to working within global delivery or distributed team models, with familiarity in leveraging offshore/onshore constructs and collaborating across matrixed organizations.

**Knowledge And Skill Requirements (Enter The Description)**

* Deep Power & Utilities sector expertise, with strong understanding of industry drivers such as energy transition, regulatory frameworks, grid modernization, asset-intensive operations, and evolving customer models.
* Familiarity with core Power & Utilities technology landscape and ecosystems, including platforms such as SAP IS‑U, Oracle Utilities, AMI/MDM systems, grid management (ADMS/EMS), and data/cloud ecosystems, with an understanding of how these enable transformation across the utilities value chain.
* Strong commercial and financial acumen, with the ability to interpret deal economics, value drivers, and business cases, and translate these into compelling, outcome-focused client narratives.
* Advanced problem-solving and structured thinking capability, with the ability to synthesize complex, multi-dimensional client challenges into clear strategic choices and actionable priorities.
* Executive-level communication and influencing skills, with the ability to engage credibly with C-suite stakeholders, simplify complex topics, and drive alignment across diverse stakeholder groups.
* Ability to operate in a global, matrixed environment, collaborating effectively across geographies, service lines, and alliance ecosystems while navigating organizational complexity and competing priorities.

**Good to have (Differentiators)**

* Strong perspective on energy transition and emerging business models, including renewables integration, distributed energy resources (DER), hydrogen, and evolving market structures, with the ability to connect these shifts to long-term utility transformation agendas.
* Exposure to grid and infrastructure modernization, including smart grids, digital substations, asset performance optimization, and resilience programs, reflecting the increasing digitization of network operations.
* Experience driving AI- and data-led transformation in asset-intensive environments, including applications such as predictive maintenance, digital twins, advanced analytics, and real-time decisioning across utility operations and customer ecosystems.
* Ability to translate global disruption trends into scalable market propositions, including navigating regulatory complexity, ESG mandates, and capital investment cycles, while identifying new growth and efficiency opportunities.
* Experience in building and leveraging ecosystem-led solutions, including working with hyperscalers, platform providers, and industrial technology partners to shape integrated, future-ready offerings in complex, multi-stakeholder environments.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
  
  
EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

Working within the Global Product Solutions team, you will be accountable for enabling the integration and optimisation of Janes’ interconnected intelligence capabilities across the APAC customer base. This includes managing and developing a high-performing engineering team, while also contributing personally to priority customer engagements where deep technical expertise and architectural judgement are required.

The role underpins Janes’ growth across the Asia-Pacific region. You will manage and work alongside the APAC Solutions team supporting mission-critical customer operations, embedding Janes data into customer environments, enabling interoperability with third-party and customer datasets, and aligning delivered solutions with customers’ AI, intelligence, and data strategies. You will play a key role in shaping how Janes data is deployed and consumed within complex, operational systems.

In addition, you will contribute to the definition and documentation of data standards, technical specifications, and integration pathways. This work will help improve customer outcomes, ensure consistency and scalability across deployments, and drive technical innovation within Janes’ solutions ecosystem.

You will contribute to high-impact customer and partner projects across the Asia-Pacific region, helping to shape the evolution of Janes’ technical estate—including our graph knowledgebase, intelligence products, and supporting infrastructure. Your work will have a direct and meaningful impact on national security and defence capability, both through the success of customer missions and the continued growth of Janes in the region.

**How you will contribute at Janes:**

* Team Leadership & Management Lead the day-to-day operation of the APAC Solutions Engineering team, setting clear priorities, providing technical coaching and mentoring, managing performance, and building capability and capacity in line with regional and global objectives.
* System Integration Lead and contribute to the integration of Janes data and models into customer systems of record, ensuring solutions are robust, operationally relevant, and aligned with customer architectures.
* Product Delivery Support the development and delivery of Janes Interconnected Intelligence products, ensuring implementations align with defined standards, technical expectations, and customer use cases.
* Customer Advisory Provide hands-on technical advisory support to customers, both remotely and on-site, offering guidance on data structures, integration approaches, and system optimisation.
* Gap Analysis Identify, assess, and prioritise unmet data and integration requirements that are critical to customer adoption and mission success.
* Strategic Expansion Contribute to the identification of adjacent content and data domains for potential expansion—organically or through acquisition—to increase Janes’ relevance to customer missions.
* Market Intelligence Monitor partner and competitor activity within customer environments, providing insight to inform collaboration opportunities, growth strategies, and risk mitigation.
* Presales & Bids Support technical presales engagements, bids, and proposals, contributing solution design, integration approaches, and subject-matter expertise.

**The ideal skills and experience for this role are:**

* People Leadership & Delivery Management
* Demonstrated experience leading technical teams, with clear accountability for delivery, performance management, coaching, and capability development.
* Proven ability to operate as a player-coach, balancing hands-on technical contribution with effective team leadership.
* Experience planning and prioritising work, managing competing demands, and ensuring consistent delivery across customer engagements.
* Confident handling escalations, providing technical direction, and representing the team with senior internal and customer stakeholders.
* Domain Expertise
* Strong experience in data integration, system interoperability, and technical advisory roles, ideally within defence, intelligence, or national security contexts.
* Deep understanding of data models, ontologies, and standards relevant to military and intelligence customers.
* Experience working directly with government, defence, or intelligence organisations, with an appreciation of operational constraints and mission priorities.
* Technical Proficiency
* Strong practical experience with Python, including APIs, SDKs, and data engineering workflows.
* Solid understanding of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) and production-grade solution delivery.
* Hands-on experience with graph database technologies (e.g. Neo4j, ArangoDB, GraphDB).
* Working knowledge of at least two of the following: ArcGIS, Palantir, relational databases (RDBMS), or graph-based platforms.
* Education & Communication
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.
* Clear and confident communicator, able to translate complex technical concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Comfortable operating within small, agile, and globally distributed teams.
* Understanding of the intelligence cycle and the ability to align technical solutions to operational requirements.
* Mindset & Professional Approach
* Delivery-focused technical leader with a pragmatic approach to solving complex customer and integration challenges.
* Able to think strategically while remaining accountable for hands-on execution and team outcomes.
* Collaborative and commercially aware, with a strong focus on customer success and team effectiveness.
* Resilient and adaptable, capable of leading teams through ambiguity, change, and high-priority delivery demands.

**Desirable Skills & Experience:**

* Front-End & Web Technologies:
* Experience with JavaScript libraries (e.g., React) or frameworks (e.g., Vue).
* Familiarity with geospatial JavaScript libraries such as ArcGIS Maps SDK, OpenLayers, Leaflet, and Cesium.
* Back-End & Infrastructure:
* Experience with Docker, Elasticsearch, or Palantir.
* Hands-on experience with cloud platforms and services, particularly AWS (EC2, Lambda, S3, etc.).
* Background in backend or frontend architecture and development.
* Geospatial & Intelligence Tools:
* Experience with Python modules such as ArcPy and ArcGIS API for Python.

title: Account Manager
description:
This is an internal role at Weekday. Not a role by a client.
  
  
  

* Role type: Full time
* Location: Remote
* Working days: Monday–Saturday
* Working with: Founders and the customer success team

Weekday is an AI-native recruiting platform. We are backed by Y Combinator and Venture Highway (now General Catalyst). We have built the largest white-collar talent database in India and have built tools to run outbound recruiting campaigns to them.
  
  
**About The Role**
A company books a demo with us because their hiring is stuck. From that first call until they're a paying, active customer, they're yours.
  
  
You won't be prospecting from zero — inbound and our own outbound put founders and talent leads on your calendar every week. What happens after is entirely on you: run the demo, understand what they're actually hiring for, show them how the database and campaign tooling solve it, close the subscription, and make sure the account starts well rather than quietly going cold in month two.
  
  
That means you carry a number, and the number is visible. A week full of warm conversations that closed nothing is a bad week, and we'll both know it. In exchange you get a product companies already want, real demand coming in, and nobody scripting your calls.
  
  
If you want a clean job description with neat boundaries, this isn't for you.
  
  
What you'll actually do
  
  
On any given day you might be:
  
  
  

* Running demos of platform.weekday.works with founders and talent leads, and reading what they actually need behind what they say they need
* Pulling live searches during the call so a prospect sees their own hiring problem solved in front of them
* Chasing the follow-up relentlessly — pricing, procurement, the person who went quiet after a great first call
* Negotiating and closing subscription deals, and knowing which ones to walk away from
* Handing accounts to customer success cleanly, and staying close enough that what you promised is what gets delivered
* Telling us honestly why deals died — pricing, product, timing, or you — so we fix the real thing
* Keeping your pipeline clean enough that your forecast means something

You'll be measured on closed subscriptions and how well those accounts hold up. Not on slides, not on calls logged.
  
  
What we're looking for
  
  
  

* You've sold before and you've closed — B2B SaaS or services, ideally to founders and startup teams
* You're sharp on a call: you listen more than you pitch, and you can push back on a prospect without losing them
* You're relentless on follow-up. Deals don't die on your watch out of neglect
* You run your own process and build your own judgment instead of waiting for a playbook
* You're honest about your numbers, including the bad weeks
* You know the Indian startup and hiring ecosystem well enough to hold a real conversation about it
* You're comfortable with ambiguity and a Monday–Saturday pace

What you get
  
  
  

* A product with real demand and real proof — 1000+ companies hire through Weekday
* Full ownership of the closing motion, with the founders a message away
* A front-row seat to how a venture-backed startup is built and run profitably
* Direct influence on pricing, positioning and what we build next, because you're the one hearing the objections
* Uncapped upside if you can close

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Team Lead-Presales
description:
**About The Company**
 We, RentoMojo, were founded by IITM alums and serial entrepreneurs who worked out of almost every major city in India
   

  

 in his first five years of corporate career. Frustrated with the hassles of relocating from one place to the other, and tired of
   

  

 finding that perfect cluster of home essentials that suited their lifestyle.
   

  

 "The spending youth, especially the millennials \& Gen Z's prefer staying light, desire flexibility and are value conscious.
   

  

 Willing to experiment with new stuff across categories that make life simpler and not boring, these generations are also
   

  

 sensitive to our planet's sustainability. Our customers and employees identify with what we do '', is what Geetansh
   

  

 Bamania, our Founder and CEO has to say.
   

  

 RentoMojo caters to the needs of the working professionals which is unmet due to nonavailability of furnished rental flats
   

  

 by offering furniture and appliances on rental basis, thus, providing more flexibility than owning the expensive furniture and
   

  

 appliances.
   

  

 Currently, we have 130,000\+ subscribers with a typical rental period of 1214 months. The current market size (as per a
   

  

 recent report by Grant Thornton) is estimated to be US$ 4\.1 Billion and expected to grow to US$ 13 Billion by 2025\.
   

  

 With 1000\+ people operations, the company has a presence in 16 cities across India. Looking back, Rentomojo has not only
   

  

 made a new market of lease which never existed for the consumer, they have also become market leaders in the consumer
   

  

 rental industry. Unlike the norm, they are now seeing a reverse trend wherein a version of ours is being copied in the US
   

  

 and UK. We are a profitable company and are excited about exponentially growing the profits of the company in months
   

  

 and years to come.
   

  

**Five Pillars Of Our Culture**
 Zoom InZoom Out :
   

  

* We zoom in and go micro; our focus would be doing better in everything, including things we already do well.
* We zoom


 out a lot for creating successful pilots that can potentially scale into a lot of value add in the future, like strengthening our
   

  

 offline presence.
   

  

 Enterprising Mindset: If you are bold enough, you will have life changing growth opportunities here.
   

  

* We will continue to expand the responsibilities of hungry and willing people. If you are ready to do what you have never done, you will find roles that you have never managed.
* Growing people from within was a significant contributor to the Fortune employers choice award that we won in 2022


 and more importantly that's one of the biggest reasons of our success \& continued momentum
   

  

 Frugality: Measure Twice and Cut once.
   

  

* It is always easy to spend more money to get more done, but it lacks any form of challenge. We have to grow and become


 better without a proportionate increase in cost.
   

  

* For every penny that we spend or that we put up to spend, expect a lot of discussions, debates and conversations.


 Planning is going to be important, data has to be the foundation, detailing will be a must and world class execution is the
   

  

 only way we will move forward in this journey.
   

  

 Accountability: Less Why, more How.
   

  

* We will always have more to bite than we can chew, we will always have to make choices and prioritize while we


 progress. We can have hundreds of reasons behind why something can not be done, but we have to remain focused on the
   

  

 how of things. The focus on how will help us find ways to get done, what needs to get done.
   

  

 Think, decide, play and act for the long term.
   

  

* The only time we will make short term decisions is when they help us in the longer term. To me, the long term is all about


 consistency and not intensity.
   

  

 Recent Media Coverage: YourStory , Dec 2022
   

  

**The Core Team**
 Geetansh Bamania \- Founder \& CEO
   

  

 Ketan Krishna \- People \& Governance Head
   

  

 Prabhat Verma \- VP of Engineering, Data \& Product
   

  

 Hakim Ujjainwala \- Head of Capital and Resourcing
   

  

 Shivendu Ojha \- Customer Operations and Sales
   

  

 Rohan Kulkarni \- Head of Corporate Finance and Strategy
   

  

 Aman Jha \- Head of Operations \& Procurement
   

  

 Akash Jangid \- Chief of Staff
   

  

 Dhruv Wahal \- AVP \- Growth and Marketing
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a high\-performing and result\-oriented Presale Assistant Manager / Manager to lead a team 20\+ presales executives. The ideal candidate should have a solid background in presales, excellent command of data tools, strong communication skills, and the ability to drive performance in a fast\-paced environment. If you have what it takes to lead from the front, motivate teams, and close the conversion gap, we want to hear from you.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead, mentor, and manage a team of presales executives/senior executives to meet lead qualification and conversion goals.
* Monitor daily performance and optimize productivity using data dashboards and CRM platforms.
* Utilize calling tools for lead management and effective customer engagement.

* Motivate the team with goal\-setting, performance tracking, and coaching to drive results.
* Generate performance reports in Excel (pivot tables, VLOOKUPs, dashboards) and present insights to management.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with Marketing and Sales teams for better funnel alignment.

**Must\-Have Skills**

* Working knowledge of calling/CRM tools such as Leadsquared, Exotel, Ameyo, etc.
* Understanding of customer psychology, lead conversion, and funnel management.
* Excellent team management, leadership, and motivational skills.
* Strong presentation and communication skills.
* Goal\-oriented with a history of achieving or exceeding targets.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree (MBA preferred).
* Industry experience in EdTech, Real Estate, Insurance, or other B2C sectors.

title: Solution Engineer - Context Graph Demo Specialist
description:
**Solution Engineer \- Context Graph Demo Specialist** 




  





**Location:** 
 Mumbai, Pune, Bengaluru, Gurugram
 



  





**Experience:** 
 Fresher to 2 Years
 



  





**Role Type** 
 : Individual Contributor (IC)
 



**Travel** 
 : 40\-50% (on\-site customer demos)
 



  





 About the Role
 



 Tata Communications is looking for an early\-career Solution Engineer to join the Solution Engineering team, focused on building and delivering demonstrations of our Context Graph capabilities. This is a highly visible, customer\-facing role for someone who enjoys translating technical concepts into compelling business stories, thinks logically under pressure, and is comfortable being on the road to present in front of customers.
 



 You'll work closely with senior solution architects, product, and sales teams to build demo environments, customize them for specific customer use cases, and present them live both virtually and on\-site.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



 Demo Build \& Ownership: Build, configure, and maintain demo environments for Context Graph, ensuring they reflect current product capabilities and are tailored to different industry use cases.
 



 Customer\-Facing Demos: Travel to customer locations (40\-50% travel) to deliver live product demonstrations, walk through use cases, and answer first\-level technical questions.
 



 Use Case Translation: Work with sales and solution architects to understand a prospect's business problem and translate it into a relevant, believable demo narrative not just a feature walkthrough.
 



 Troubleshooting on the Fly: Diagnose and resolve demo environment issues quickly, including during live customer sessions, with a calm and structured approach.
 



 Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Product, Engineering, and Sales teams to stay current on roadmap changes, feedback loops from the field, and competitive positioning.
 



 Documentation: Maintain demo scripts, environment setup guides, and reusable assets so demos can scale across the team.
 



 Continuous Learning: Build depth in graph data concepts, knowledge graphs, and how Context Graph fits into broader enterprise data and AI strategies.
 



  





  





**What We're Looking For** 




 Must\-Have:
 



 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field (freshers welcome) or up to 2 years of relevant experience.
 



 Strong logical and analytical thinking able to break down a customer problem and map it to a technical solution.
 



  





 Ontology\-first thinking demonstrated ability to model an enterprise s objects, actions and processes as a reusable semantic layer, with metadata, permissions and data structures kept consistent, secure, and scalable Ontology.
 



 Basic understanding of data structures, databases, or graph concepts (formal experience not required, but genuine curiosity and aptitude expected).
 



 Good business acumen able to understand a customer's commercial context, not just their technical ask.
 



 Comfortable with public speaking / presenting to small and large groups, including senior stakeholders.
 



 Willingness and ability to travel 40\-50% of the time for on\-site customer demos.
 



 Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
 



  





 Good to Have (not mandatory):
 



 Exposure to graph databases (Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, TigerGraph, etc.) or knowledge graph concepts.
 



 Familiarity with SQL, Python, or basic scripting.
 



 Prior internship or project experience involving customer\-facing work, hackathons, or product demos.
 



 Understanding of enterprise IT, telecom, or B2B SaaS environments.
 



  





  





 What Success Looks Like in This Role
 



 Demo environments are reliable, current, and reusable across the team.
 



 Customers leave demo sessions with a clear understanding of how Context Graph solves their specific problem.
 



 You build a reputation internally as someone who can be trusted to represent the product in front of a customer.
 



 You progress toward owning more complex, custom\-built demos and eventually pre\-sales solutioning independently.
 



  





  





 Why Join Tata Communications
 



 Front\-row seat to how enterprise customers evaluate and adopt cutting\-edge graph and AI\-driven solutions.
 



 Direct mentorship from senior solution architects and exposure to the full sales cycle.
 



 Fast\-tracked learning curve: technical depth \+ commercial exposure \+ customer\-facing skills, all in one role.
 



 Clear growth path into Solution Architecture, Pre\-Sales, or Product roles.

* Act as a crucial part of the sales team, providing technical insight and solutions to prospective and existing platform users. Guide and provide technical expertise on Stripe and its benefits.

* Manage pre\-sales projects, coordinating proof of concept development, and feasibility checks. Ensure all solutions proposed are viable, beneficial to our potential clients, and also accommodating to their customers.


 Who you are
   

  

 We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.
   

  

**Minimum Requirements**
* 4\+ years of experience in a similar customer\-facing engineering role such as solution consultant, solutions architect, or sales engineer, for a global software enterprise.
* Executive engagement skills and presence, with an ability to establish strong relationships with key decision makers and build credibility at all levels.
* Effective group\-facilitation skills and confidence in proposing and leading customer meetings to gain strategic footing and pursue opportunities.
* Thorough understanding of the software development lifecycle and API architecture.
* Outstanding spoken and written communication skills, presentation skills, and confidence in explaining complex concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Gather an in\-depth understanding of all of Stripe’s products and their applicability across diverse business models to beneficially cater to individual clients' and their customers' needs.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* \* Experience as a customer facing, domain expert in the payments space, presenting, and architecting solutions for platform customers.
+ Prior experience driving technical sales and supporting them and their customer’s unique requirements
+ Can read, write, and understand code in one to many programming languages
+ Experience with integrating Stripe or other RESTful APIs into web applications.
+ Experience in systems design, building and deploying complex applications.
+ Passionate about learning and actively seeks out knowledge
+ Ability to work independently and confidently to develop a path forward with customers under ambiguous circumstances.
+ Strategic and creative thinker who can proactively identify challenges and maintain a positive approach when facing difficult obstacles.
+ Strong collaboration skills to work seamlessly with extended global teams to support our users.


 In\-office expectations
   

  

 Office\-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in\-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in\-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.
   

  

 Pay and benefits
   

  

 Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.
   

  

 We look forward to hearing from you.
   

  

 At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

* Act as a trusted technical advisor to client stakeholders, translating business requirements into scalable, well\-governed data architectures.
* Mentor data engineers and architects on project teams; contribute to reusable accelerators and IP for the practice.
* Stay current with the Fabric roadmap and broader Microsoft data platform ecosystem, bringing new capabilities into client proposals and solutions.


**Qualifications**
**Required Skills \& Experience**
* 12–15 years in data engineering/architecture roles, with the most recent chapter as a Data Architect actively implementing Microsoft Fabric\-based solutions.
* Hands\-on architecture experience with Microsoft Fabric: OneLake, Lakehouse, Data Warehouse, Data Factory pipelines/dataflows, Notebooks (Spark), and Power BI integration.

* Experience mentoring teams and owning technical delivery quality on medium\-to\-large engagements.

 :
 **Staff Cloud Network Architect** 




 The Staff Cloud Network Architect is a strategic, customer\-facing technical role responsible for ensuring the success of enterprise customers operating Aviatrix in production environments. description:
You are curious about how artificial intelligence is reshaping the way global supply chains are designed, planned, and operated. You understand that the future of supply chain is not just about automation — it's about intelligent systems that learn, adapt, and collaborate. You bring a blend of functional supply chain knowledge and a growing fluency in enterprise AI concepts, and you're energized by the challenge of turning that combination into tangible value for clients.
   

  

 You're comfortable moving between structured analysis and open\-ended problem\-solving. You ask good questions, synthesize complex information quickly, and communicate your thinking clearly — whether you're mapping a demand\-planning process, drafting a functional specification, or helping a client imagine what an AI\-powered supply chain could look like. You're eager to grow, take direction well, and understand that great consulting outcomes are built on meticulous preparation and disciplined thinking.
   

  

**THE WORK**
 Utilize relevant AI tools across all tasks and deliverable creation, including the creation of agents and other tools to help facilitate:
   

  

**Supply Chain AI Strategy \& Use Case Development**
* Identify, assess, and prioritize AI use cases across supply chain domains — Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Manufacturing, Procurement, Aftermarket, and Fulfillment — by mapping current\-state processes to AI\-enabled future states.
* Support the development of Business Requirements Documents (BRDs) and Functional Requirements Documents (FRDs) grounded in supply chain functional knowledge and client\-specific context.
* Contribute to AI reference architecture designs tailored for supply chain environments, illustrating how agentic AI components interact with enterprise data platforms, ERP systems, and planning tools.
* Assist in crafting AI value cases and business cases that articulate ROI, risk, and transformation timelines for supply chain\-specific AI initiatives.


**Client Engagement \& Advisory Support**
* Support client workshops and discovery sessions by preparing materials, capturing requirements, and synthesizing stakeholder inputs across supply chain functions.
* Prepare client\-facing presentations, roadmaps, and strategy decks that translate AI and data concepts into accessible narratives for supply chain and operations leaders.
* Apply Design Thinking principles to facilitate structured problem definition and solution ideation sessions with client teams.
* Maintain and evolve the team's repository of supply chain AI frameworks, benchmarks, and industry case examples.


**Data \& AI Foundations**
* Develop foundational fluency in enterprise data concepts — data products, data pipelines, and agentic AI hierarchies — as they apply to supply chain planning and execution systems.
* Support data analysis tasks to surface insights from supply chain datasets (e.g., forecast accuracy, inventory performance, supplier scorecards) in service of client recommendations.
* Explore and apply prompt engineering and RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation) techniques to build or enhance AI tools that support supply chain advisory workflows.
* Complete assigned AI literacy and continuous\-learning modules, contributing to a culture of applied innovation within the team.

title: Bid Management Consultant
description:
**Role Summary**
 Avanade India is looking for a Pre\-Sales Bid Manager to run our pursuits from first qualification to signed contract. This is the person who owns the bid — the plan, the calendar, the win themes, the response, the pricing inputs and the stakeholders — so that solution architects and sales leaders can focus on the client and the solution while the bid itself runs on time and to a high standard.
   

  

 You will manage multiple RFPs, RFIs and proactive proposals at once, working across sales, solution architects, delivery, finance, legal, Microsoft and partner teams. We expect you to use Gen AI tools as a core part of how you work — to analyse RFPs, draft and reuse content, check compliance and produce stronger responses in less time — and to bring that way of working to the teams around you. Knowledge of the Microsoft ecosystem is a significant advantage, as most of our pursuits are built on it.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own end\-to\-end bid management for assigned pursuits — from lead qualification and bid/no\-bid decision through response, orals, negotiation support and deal closure.
* Run the bid qualification process: gather opportunity intelligence, assess fit and win probability, and prepare the bid/no\-bid case for leadership.
* Build and run the bid plan — timelines, owners, review gates, internal deadlines and a clear RACI across contributors.
* Analyse RFPs and RFIs in detail — requirements, evaluation criteria, commercial and contractual terms — and maintain the compliance matrix and clarification log.
* Define win themes, value propositions and differentiators with sales and solution leads, and make sure they run through every section of the response.
* Coordinate solution architects, delivery leads and subject\-matter experts to produce the solution, approach, plan, team structure and assumptions on time.
* Work with finance and the deal team on price modelling — effort and resource\-based pricing, fixed price, time and materials, managed services and outcome\-based models — including rate cards, margin, contingency and commercial assumptions.
* Manage risk, legal and contractual review with legal, compliance and delivery assurance teams, including deviations, terms and risk registers.
* Use Gen AI tools across the bid lifecycle — RFP summarisation and requirement extraction, first\-draft generation, content reuse from the proposal library, compliance checking, editing and consistency review — while owning the accuracy and quality of what goes out.
* Build and maintain a reusable proposal content library — case studies, credentials, CVs, boilerplate and approach sections — structured so both people and AI tools can use it well.
* Engage external stakeholders — clients, Microsoft account and partner teams, third\-party partners and subcontractors — for clarifications, joint positioning, co\-sell and partner inputs.
* Produce the final response to a high standard — structure, writing, formatting, graphics and executive summary — and run the quality reviews (pink, red and gold team or equivalent) before submission.
* Prepare the team for orals, demos and clarification meetings — storyboards, presentation decks, rehearsals and Q\&A preparation.
* Support negotiation and closure — BAFO responses, commercial revisions, SOW and contract finalisation — through to handover into delivery.
* Track pursuit pipeline, status and outcomes in CRM, run win/loss reviews, and feed lessons learned back into the bid process and content library.


**Qualifications**
* 8–12 years of experience in IT services, with at least 5 years in bid management, proposal management or pre\-sales.
* Proven end\-to\-end bid management experience — owning complex RFP/RFI responses and proactive proposals from qualification through to closure.
* Clear understanding of the full pre\-sales lifecycle: lead, qualification, bid/no\-bid, solutioning, pricing, response, orals, negotiation, contracting and handover to delivery.
* Hands\-on use of Gen AI tools (for example Microsoft 365 Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, or proposal tools such as Loopio, Responsive or Qvidian with AI features) to improve bid productivity, with a clear view of where they help and where human review is essential.
* Working understanding of price modelling in IT services — pricing constructs, rate cards, effort\-based pricing, margin, contingency and commercial risk — and the ability to work with finance on the deal model.
* Proven ability to coordinate internal stakeholders across sales, solutioning, delivery, finance and legal, and external stakeholders including clients, partners and vendors.
* Strong skills in RFP analysis, compliance management, bid planning and running review gates to deadline.
* Excellent business writing and editing — able to turn technical input into a clear, persuasive, client\-focused response and executive summary.
* Strong presentation skills in PowerPoint, Word and Excel, and comfort producing polished proposal documents under time pressure.
* Ability to manage several concurrent bids, prioritise effectively and hold contributors to commitments without direct authority.
* Good understanding of IT services offerings — application development, cloud, data, AI, business applications and managed services.


**Preferred / Good To Have**
* Knowledge of the Microsoft ecosystem and technologies — Azure, Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Microsoft 365, Fabric and Copilot — and how they are positioned and sold.
* Experience with Microsoft partner programmes and motions — co\-sell, Microsoft funding and incentive programmes, and partner solution positioning.
* Experience in a Microsoft partner, consulting, global delivery or SI environment (Avanade, Accenture, or similar).
* Bid or proposal management certification — APMP Foundation or Practitioner, or equivalent.
* Experience with CRM and pursuit tracking tools such as Dynamics 365 Sales or Salesforce.
* Experience building AI\-assisted bid processes — prompt libraries, Copilot agents or automated content retrieval for proposal teams.
* Experience with public sector, BFSI or large enterprise procurement processes and formal tenders.
* Graphic or visual storytelling skills for proposals and orals.
* Experience with pursuits across India and the wider APAC region.

description:

**Job Description**

You will play a critical role in helping customers identify industry\-leading sorting solutions for their processing challenges while maximizing the value of TOMRA's technology.

If you're naturally curious, enjoy solving problems, and are motivated by helping customers achieve successful outcomes, you'll have the opportunity to build expertise in industry\-leading sorting technologies while supporting customers from our Bangalore Demonstration Facility and across Southeast Asia and the wider APAC region.
   

  





 Fluency in written and spoken English is required. Proficiency in additional Indian languages would be advantageous.

* Share knowledge across regional and global teams

title: Professional Services Engineer
description:
**ABOUT XPLORETEQ** 




 Xploreteq is a Pune\-based technology and cybersecurity company working with organisations across cybersecurity, AI governance, data protection and DPDP readiness — through advisory, implementation and managed services. We are ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certified, serve 50\+ enterprise customers across financial services, healthcare, technology, manufacturing and services, and partner with leading platforms including Netskope, CrowdStrike, Menlo Security, Proofpoint, Okta, Varonis and Forcepoint. As we scale our team across sales, delivery and operations, we're looking for people who want to build a specialist practice rather than join a generalist IT shop.
 



  





**ROLE OVERVIEW** 




 We are seeking a client\-facing Professional Services Engineer to lead the technical implementation, architecture and integration of edge security solutions for our enterprise clients. Working from a System Integrator perspective, you will assess client environments, design the deployment architecture, and execute migrations onto modern Zero\-Trust platforms — bridging legacy infrastructure (on\-prem proxies, MPLS) and cloud\-native SASE/SSE.
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




**Assessment \& Design** 




 •   Lead technical discovery workshops to map legacy architecture, application portfolios and traffic flows.
 



 •   Author High\-Level and Low\-Level Design documentation covering traffic steering, proxy chaining, SSL decryption policy and fallback mechanisms.
 



 •   Help clients plan prerequisites — allowlists, firewall exceptions, certificate authority provisioning, IdP sync.
 



**SASE/SSE Implementation** 




 •   Build, configure and validate tenants covering Secure Web Gateway, CASB and ZTNA.
 



 •   Implement DLP policies aligned to client regulatory requirements (PCI\-DSS, HIPAA, GDPR, DPDP) with custom detection rules.
 



 •   Configure traffic steering and client deployment via MDM/GPO, including bypass and smart\-steering rules.
 



 •   Deploy Remote Browser Isolation and content\-sanitisation (CDR) controls where in scope.
 



**Integration \& Go\-Live** 




 •   Integrate platforms with client Identity Providers (Azure AD/Entra ID, Okta) for provisioning and group\-based policy.
 



 •   Configure log/event forwarding into the client's SIEM (Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, etc.).
 



 •   Design and execute UAT test matrices; provide post\-go\-live hypercare support; run technical training and handover sessions for the client's internal operations team.
 



**REQUIRED TECHNICAL SKILLS \& QUALIFICATIONS** 




 •   3–6 years as a Cyber Security Engineer, Consultant or Professional Services engineer, ideally within a System Integrator or MSP.
 



 •   Hands\-on deployment experience with at least one SASE/SSE platform (Netskope preferred) or isolation platform (Menlo Security); familiarity with a second (Zscaler, Palo Alto Prisma Access, Forcepoint) is a strong plus.
 



 •   Working knowledge of proxy configuration (PAC files, explicit vs. transparent), GRE/IPsec tunnelling, TLS/SSL inspection and routing fundamentals.
 



 •   Experience deploying endpoint agents at scale via Intune, SCCM, JAMF or GPO.
 



**PREFERRED CERTIFICATIONS** 




 •   Netskope Cloud Security Integrator (NCSI) or Cloud Security Administrator (NCSA).
 



 •   Palo Alto PCNSE, CISSP or CCSP are a plus.
 



**COMPETENCIES \& SOFT SKILLS** 




 •   Comfortable walking into varied, unpredictable client environments and deploying a modern security stack on top of messy legacy networks.
 



 •   Strong documentation discipline for HLD/LLDs and runbooks.
 



 •   Able to run more than one client engagement at different lifecycle stages at once.
 



**WHAT WE VALUE** 




 At Xploreteq, we value people who take responsibility, communicate openly, solve problems practically, and contribute beyond the boundaries of a job description. For this role, we're particularly looking for someone who can be dropped into a messy client environment and bring order to it.
 



**REPORTING** 




 Reports to the Tech Lead.
 



**TO APPLY** 




 Interested candidates can share their updated CV to HR@xploreteq.com along with:
 



 •   Current CTC
 



 •   Expected CTC
 



 •   Notice period
 



 •   Current location
 



 •   Brief summary of relevant experience for this role

title: Founder's Office (Growth & GTM)
description:
This is an internal role at Weekday. Not a role by a client.
   

  

  

* Role type: Full time
* Location: Remote
* Working with: CEO and Cofounder


 Weekday is an AI\-native recruiting platform. We are backed by Y Combinator and Venture Highway (now General Catalyst). We have built the largest white collar talent database in India and have built tools to run outbound recruiting campaigns to them.
   

  

**About The Role**
 This is a growth role, not a strategy role. You will sit next to the CEO and own one number: revenue growth for one of our core product lines. Everything you do — every piece of content, every cold email, every demo call — either moves that number or it doesn't.
   

  

 You won't be handed a playbook, a team, or a warmed\-up pipeline. You'll build the GTM engine yourself: figure out which channels work, build them, and scale the ones that do. Some weeks that means writing content and tuning SEO/AEO so buyers find us. Other weeks it means running demo calls back\-to\-back and following up aggressively until deals close. If you think of yourself as either "a marketer" or "a salesperson" but not both, this isn't for you.
   

  

 What you'll actually do
   

  

 On any given day you might be:
   

  

  

* Running the full inside\-sales motion — taking demo calls, handling objections, following up relentlessly, and closing
* Building content that actually converts: landing pages, comparison pages, blog posts, and material designed to rank on search and get picked up by AI answer engines (AEO)
* Setting up and running outbound systems — cold email, cold calls, LinkedIn, or whatever channel gets us in front of the right buyers
* Writing scripts and light automations to scale yourself — scraping lead lists, wiring up email sequences, building dashboards so you know what's working
* Testing a new growth channel, killing it fast if it doesn't work, and doubling down if it does
* Reporting your numbers honestly to the founders, including the ugly ones


 You'll be measured on revenue — pipeline created and deals closed. Not on activity, not on slides.
   

  

 What we're looking for
   

  

  

* You can sell. You're sharp on calls, you can run a demo that lands, and you follow up like the deal depends on it — because it does
* You know your way around code and tech. You can write a script, wire up an API, or build your own tooling instead of waiting for an engineer
* You've done growth before — content, SEO, cold email, cold calling, or any sales system you built and ran yourself — and you can show what it produced
* You take ownership. When the number is yours, it moves — no follow\-ups needed
* You work hard and sweat the details. Conscientiousness isn't optional here; the follow\-up you skip is the deal you lose
* You're comfortable with ambiguity. No playbook, no hand\-holding, no fully\-defined role. The role is what you make it


 What you get
   

  

  

* Full ownership of a revenue line — you're not a cog in a GTM machine, you are the GTM machine
* A daily working relationship with the CEO and Cofounder, and a front\-row seat to how a profitable, venture\-backed startup grows
* The freedom to pick your channels and build your own systems — and the accountability that comes with it
* The kind of zero\-to\-one growth experience that's worth far more than the title

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
