title: Solutions Architect, IT Services
description:
**Description**
* Do you like helping customers solve technical problems?
* Would you like to do this using the latest cloud computing technologies?
* Do you have a knack for helping companies understand Emerging Technology Domains such as GenAI, Agentic AI, Analytics , Microservices architectures including the integration approaches?
* Do you thrive on rolling up your sleeves , a Builder who can help Architect new and emerging technologies along with been consultative to ensure success?
* Do you want to be part of the Retail / CPG team helping to establish Amazon Web Services as a leading technology platform for some of the largest Brands \& Customers in India.


 AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer\-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.
   

  

 As a Solution Architect, you will have the opportunity to help shape and deliver on a strategy to build mind share and broad use of Amazon’s utility computing web services within strategic accounts and partners. Your broad responsibilities will include: owning the technical engagement and ultimate success around specific implementation projects, and developing a deep expertise in the Amazon Web Services technologies as well as broad know\-how around how applications and services are constructed using the Amazon Web Services platform.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will possess customer\-facing skills that will allow him/her to represent AISPL well within a customer’s environment and drive discussions with senior personnel within the company, as well as a technical background that enables him/her to easily interact and give guidance to software developers and architects. He/she should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, product, and technical challenges.
   

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities**
* Serve as a key technical member of the Retail/CPG Account team in helping to ensure customer success in building applications and services on the Amazon Web Services platform.
* Scope each customer engagement, with attention towards clear and well\-defined objectives and success criteria.
* Own each technical engagement, and help ensure a timely and successful delivery of value. (delivery of actual solutions to be done by Amazon Web Services partners)
* Capture and share best\-practice knowledge amongst the solution architect community.
* Understand the Amazon Web Services market segments, customer base, and industry verticals.


 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 This role is within the Retail/CPG team in Amazon Web Services India (AWS India) and based out of
   

  

 Delhi
   

  

* As a Solutions Architect, you’ll help your customers plan their successful cloud journey leveraging emerging technologies like GenAI to achieve business outcomes. You’ll solve complex, technical challenges so your customers can focus on their business. This includes using your knowledge to craft scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures. You’ll drive or take part in technical solutions discussions, diving deep into the details with customer teams.
* Building relationships to understand our customers and partners is key. As a trusted technical advisor, you’ll use your interpersonal skills to influence a variety of stakeholders from technical teams to executives. You’ll help ensure their short\-term technology decisions are aligned with their long\-term goals. Speeding up the adoption of our services will be part of your day to day.
* You’ll also act as thought leader in the wider community. This includes taking part in educating, sharing best practices, presenting at events, writing white papers, blogs, and running workshops. You won’t just be part of an industry movement; you’ll be leading it.
* As a customer obsessed advisor, you’ll also have the chance to shape the direction of our products and services. This is through gathering feedback from customers whilst collaborating with our engineering and service teams.


 To be successful in this role you need to be passionate builder with genuine curiosity about how technology can support your customers’ business models and objectives.
   

  

 Want to find out what it’s like to be a Solution Architect at AWS? Watch this video (https://bit.ly/3keYcC9\).
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 The Solutions Architect team at AWS is responsible for helping customers successfully implement cloud technologies. In a typical week you will meet multiple customers, and you will collaborate with them on designing and operating well\-architected solutions. You will earn their trust and show them the art of the possible, educating them around the capabilities of AWS. Partnering with internal teams and experts, leveraging a deep knowledge of our tools and products, you’ll craft highly scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures that address our customers’ business problems. As part of our team, you’ll have the opportunity to continuously learn and innovate daily.
   

  

 Want to learn more about being a Solutions Architect at AMAZON, follow the link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v\=Js21xKMFdww
   

  

**About The Team**
 Retail/CPG Solutions Architects work hand in hand with AWS customers to help drive AWS services adoption. They are at the crossroads of business and technology and engage with customers of different stages. Supporting the overall technical relationship between customers and AWS, they work to understand the customer's business needs and give prescriptive guidance on how to create business value with technology. Solutions Architects also have broader impact at scale, taking a supporting role in creating and presenting technical content and best practices.
   

  

 You will be part of a team that is responsible for driving adoption of AWS technologies while bringing differentiated value to customers. This is a team dedicated to some of the largest Brands/Services/Ecommerce customers in India . This customers follow unique technology adoption patterns and growth trajectories that distinguish them from traditional businesses, so you will be employing engagement strategies and programs tailored to their business needs and technical preferences.
   

  

 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS?
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
   

  

 Mentorship \& Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Experience with one of the following programming languages: Python, Ruby, Node.js, C\#, or C\+\+
* Experience with two or more of the following: networking fundamentals, security, storage or databases (relational or NoSQL), operating systems (Unix, Linux, or Windows)


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience implementing a cloud\-based technology solution
* Experience in any of the following: Cloud Architecture, Systems Design, Software Development, Infrastructure Architecture, Data Engineering or DevOps


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: S&C GN - SC&E - SCM Planning - O9 - Consultant
description:
**Supply Chain \& Engineering (Direct Spend Optimization): Manager**
**Direct Materials Spend Optimization**
 At Accenture, we work across industries to address our client’s most complex challenges, bringing together innovative talent and emerging technologies.
   

  

**Practice:** 
 Strategy \& Consulting, Supply Chain \& Engineering (Direct Spend Optimization)
   

  

**Level:** 
 Manager \|
 **Experience:** 
 9\+ years
   

  

**Areas of Work:** 
 Direct Spend Optimization, EBITDA improvement, Should Costing \& Teardowns, Design to Value, Strategic Sourcing, Supplier Resilience, AI/ Agentic Procurement
   

  

**Locations:** 
 Delhi, Gurgaon, Mumbai, Bangalore, Pune, Hyderabad, Chennai
   

  

**Explore an Exciting Career at Accenture**
 As part of Supply Chain \& Engineering (Direct Spend Optimization), you will help clients improve EBITDA and build more resilient supply chains by transforming Direct Materials, the supplier facing materials, components and externally manufactured inputs that flow directly into products.
   

  

 The role combines deep direct category expertise with engineering led cost transformation, strategic sourcing, supplier ecosystem design, digital/ AI enablement, and disciplined value realization. You will work across the full Direct Materials agenda what to buy, where to buy, who to buy from, for how much, how and when to buy, and how to sustain value.
   

  

**What You Will Work On**
* Direct Materials diagnostics and value assessments: Establish spend/category baselines, identify cost drivers and size opportunities using spend, BOM, supplier, specification, and operational data.
* Should\-costing, teardowns \& Design\-to\-Value: Build bottom\-up should cost models using BOMs, drawings/ CAD, material and process inputs; conduct product/component teardowns and competitive benchmarking; identify value through VA/VE, specification optimization, part/ SKU standardization, make vs buy and complexity reduction.
* Strategic sourcing and commercial excellence: Develop category strategies, run competitive sourcing, fact\-based negotiations, contract optimization, commodity intelligence, price risk/hedging and total cost of ownership interventions; incorporate sustainability into overall strategies.
* Supplier ecosystem and resilience: Support best country sourcing, localization, alternate supplier discovery, supplier consolidation, dual/multi\-sourcing, supply network optimization, and risk mitigation.
* AI/ Agentic Direct Procurement: Shape and deploy practical AI/ GenAI/ Agentic use cases across spend analytics, should cost modelling, supplier discovery, commodity and market intelligence, guided negotiation, complexity reduction, tariff intelligence, and Source to Pay workflows.
* Value realization and sustainment: Translate opportunities into business cases, execution roadmaps, contracted savings, supplier performance mechanisms, operating\-model improvements, and managed\-service/ continuous\-improvement models.


**Bring your best skills forward to excel in the role**
* Strong analytical problem solving with the ability to connect commercial, engineering, supply chain and financial data.
* Ability to work across Procurement, Engineering/ R\&D, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Finance and Technology stakeholders.
* Strong client leadership, communication, executive presentation, and team management skills.
* Comfort with digital, analytics and emerging AI technologies, with a practical focus on measurable business outcomes.


**Role Details**
**Drive client value creation**
* Understand the client business, product economics, direct material cost base, leadership priorities and value agenda.
* Co\-create transformation strategies spanning cost, margin, resilience, productivity and AI\-enabled procurement.
* Build credibility with C\-suite and functional leaders through deep industry/category understanding and fact\-based insights.


**Lead program delivery**
* Lead Direct Materials engagements from rapid diagnostic and value assessment through sourcing, negotiation, implementation and sustained value realization.
* Guide teams across spend/ BOM analytics, should\-costing, teardown/value engineering, commodity and market intelligence, sourcing strategy, supplier assessment, risk analysis, business cases and roadmaps.
* Ensure value is translated into executable actions, finance aligned benefits and scalable client capabilities.


**Grow The Business And Our Capabilities**
* Support/originate Direct Materials opportunities, shape client propositions and develop differentiated commercial pathways.
* Bring together category, engineering, industry, data/ AI and technology capabilities to solve client problems end to end.
* Develop reusable assets, playbooks and points of view across Direct Materials transformation and Agentic AI.


**Preferred Industry And Category Experience**
* Industries: CPG, Industrial \& Automotive, Oil \& Gas, Chemicals, High Tech, Retail, Health \& Life Sciences, Metals \& Mining industry experience would be preferred
* Categories: Metals/ steel/ alloys/ castings; plastics and resins; electronics/ PCBs/ components; chemicals; packaging; food ingredients/ agri commodities; pulp \& paper; mining equipment/ consumables; contract manufacturing; and other product\-critical direct categories.
* Experience in consulting and global/ multi\-country transformation programs is desirable.
* Experience leading mid to large teams and managing senior client stakeholders across complex transformation programs.
* Working knowledge of Excel and visualization/ analytics tools such as Power BI/ Alteryx; exposure to AI/ GenAI/ Agentic AI solutions in procurement is desirable.


**What's in it for you?**
* Opportunity to work on high impact Direct Materials transformation programs for leading global clients, with a direct line of sight to COGS, EBITDA and supply resilience.
* Work at the intersection of procurement, engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, data and AI moving from strategy through implementation and value realization.
* Build deep expertise across direct categories, should\-costing, Design to Value, supplier ecosystems and AI\-enabled/Agentic procurement solutions.
* Collaborate with strategy leaders, industry specialists, engineers, data/AI practitioners and global delivery teams to create differentiated client outcomes.
* Access structured learning and development to deepen consulting, category, technology and leadership capabilities in a globally connected environment.


**About Accenture**
 Accenture is a leading global professional services company that helps organizations build their digital core, optimize operations, accelerate revenue growth and enhance services creating tangible value at speed and scale. Our Strategy \& Consulting teams combine industry, functional, technology and delivery expertise to help clients reinvent how they operate and compete.
   

  

 Within Supply Chain \& Engineering (Direct Spend Optimization), our Direct Materials work brings together deep category expertise, engineering and product\-cost capabilities, strategic sourcing, AI / Agentic assets and global delivery to drive measurable and sustainable client value.
   

  

**About Accenture Strategy \& Consulting**
 Accenture Strategy \& Consulting works with clients on their most critical business and operating model challenges, combining deep business insight with technology and data. Global Network teams complement in\-country teams to deliver specialized expertise and measurable value across the client lifecycle.
   

  

 At the heart of every great change is a great human. If you have ideas, ingenuity and a passion for making a difference, come and be a part of our team.

* deployments.

title: Presales Engineer
description:
**About Covlant** 

  






 Covlant is building the AI\-native quality layer for modern software teams. Most engineering organizations face the same trade\-off on every release: run the entire regression suite and wait hours for feedback, or run a subset and risk letting defects slip into production. Covlant removes that trade\-off.
 




  






 Our AI\-driven impact testing platform analyzes every pull request against a deep map of the entire codebase to understand exactly what changed and what that change affects. It then selects the right tests from a team's existing suites to cover the impacted code paths. Where coverage is missing, Covlant's quality agents generate and validate new tests, so only meaningful, trustworthy tests are run. Engineers and QA teams stay in control through a clear review experience that shows what was tested, what passed or failed, and why.
 




  






 The result is faster feedback loops, leaner regression cycles, lower test\-maintenance overhead, and greater confidence in every release. Covlant fits into the tools teams already use across their CI/CD pipelines and development workflows.
 




  






 We're an early\-stage company working with enterprise engineering and QA teams, and we're growing our team in Bangalore. Joining Covlant now means shaping how the product is positioned, sold, and adopted, working closely with founders, Product, and Engineering, and helping define a new category in software quality.
 




  




**Role \- Presales Engineer** 

  






 Covlant is hiring a customer\-facing Presales Engineer to lead technical discovery, tailored demos, proof\-of\-concepts, and solution design for enterprise prospects evaluating our software testing and quality\-engineering platform.
 




  






 The ideal candidate combines a strong technical foundation in QA space with customer\-facing solutioning experience. They should be able to engage credibly with engineering and QA teams, understand complex testing challenges, and articulate Covlant’s capabilities in terms of tangible operational and business outcomes.
 




  




**Key responsibilities** 

  




* Lead technical discovery to understand a prospect’s applications, testing maturity, release workflow, toolchain, integrations, security needs, stakeholders, and decision criteria.
* Deliver tailored product demos, workshops, architecture discussions, and technical presentations for QA, engineering, IT, and executive stakeholders.
* Scope and run POCs with clear use cases, customer commitments, success criteria, milestones, risks, and a conversion plan.
* Partner with Account Executives/Sales leadership to develop technical win plans, address objections, and progress enterprise opportunities.
* Handle technical evaluations, RFP/RFI responses, security questionnaires, integration discussions, and solution\-design requests.
* Advise prospects on test automation strategy, CI/CD integration, test reliability, regression efficiency, and implementation best practices.
* Translate product capabilities into quantified customer value—for example, reduced regression effort, faster release cycles, lower test\-maintenance cost, improved automation coverage, and reduced production\-defect risk—and build credible ROI/value cases for buyers.
* Create reusable demo environments, discovery frameworks, POC templates, solution briefs, and competitive/technical collateral.
* Feed recurring customer needs, objections, gaps, and market insights back to Product, Engineering, and GTM teams.
* Ensure a structured technical handoff from closed\-won opportunities to implementation or customer\-success teams.



  




**Ideal candidate profile** 

  




* 4–7 years of overall experience, with meaningful early hands\-on work in software development, QA, SDET, test automation, or implementation.
* 2–4 years in a customer\-facing technical role: Presales Engineer, Solutions Engineer, Solution Consultant, Technical Consultant, or similar.
* Strong experience in QA/testing and automation, including practical familiarity with tools and concepts such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, Appium, API testing, CI/CD, Git, Jira, Jenkins/GitHub Actions, cloud testing, and test frameworks.
* Can communicate confidently with QA leads, engineering leaders, architects, product teams, and executive sponsors.
* Has led or materially contributed to tailored demos, POCs, technical discovery, solution proposals, and enterprise evaluations.
* Comfortable navigating integrations, APIs, SSO/RBAC, security reviews, cloud/SaaS architecture, and enterprise buying processes.
* Commercially aware: able to turn technical outcomes into a business case, quantify impact, and support sales teams through complex deal cycles.
* High ownership and comfortable operating in an early\-stage SaaS environment.

Our teams empower organizations across the globe to create, secure, and run applications that enhance how we experience our evolving digital world. We are passionate about cybersecurity, from protecting consumers from fraud to enabling companies to focus on innovation.
   

  

 Everything we do centers around people. That means we obsess over how to make the lives of our customers, and their customers, better. And it means we prioritize a diverse F5 community where each individual can thrive.
   

  

 At F5, we strive to bring a better digital world to life. Our teams empower organizations across the globe to create, secure, and run applications that enhance how we experience our evolving digital world. We are passionate about cybersecurity, from protecting consumers from fraud to enabling companies to focus on innovation.
   

  

 Everything we do centers around people. That means we obsess over how to make the lives of our customers, and their customers, better. And it means we prioritize a diverse F5 community where each individual can thrive.
   

  

**Role Overview:**
 We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Principal Solution Engineer with deep expertise in F5 Inc. technologies and a forward\-thinking understanding of emerging technologies like AI and containerization to join our dynamic team. In this pivotal role, you will be responsible for designing and implementing robust, scalable, and secure application delivery and security solutions, leveraging the full capabilities of the F5 product suite, including F5 Distributed Cloud, while also considering the architectural implications of modern AI and cloud\-native deployments.
   

  

 You will act as a trusted advisor and contribute to thought leadership, collaborating with sales, engineering, and client stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical architecture and drive successful project outcomes. You will also play a key role in supporting the Product and Engineering teams with the adoption and go\-to\-market strategy of new F5 products and features and potentially presenting at significant industry events.
   

  

 Sounds interesting? Read on!
   

  

**What You’ll Do:**
* Serve as the subject matter expert for F5 Inc. solutions, including BIG\-IP (LTM, GTM, APM, AWAF), NGINX, and F5 Distributed Cloud Services.
* Design and architect comprehensive application delivery and security solutions that meet client requirements for performance, scalability, security, and high availability, with consideration for AI workloads and containerized environments, potentially leveraging F5 Distributed Cloud.
* Lead technical discussions with clients to understand their business needs, technical constraints, and articulate the value proposition of F5 Inc. solutions, including F5 Distributed Cloud, in the context of their overall IT landscape, including AI initiatives.
* Develop detailed solution designs, including diagrams, specifications, and implementation plans, potentially incorporating F5 (including Distributed Cloud) in support of AI Factories, RAG implementations, and AI Gateways.
* Provide technical guidance and support to sales teams during the pre\-sales process, including presentations, demonstrations, and proposal development, highlighting how F5 Inc. solutions, including F5 Distributed Cloud, can enhance the delivery and security of AI\-powered applications.
* Collaborate with engineering teams during the implementation and deployment phases, ensuring adherence to the defined architecture.
* Stay up to date with the latest F5 Inc. product updates, industry trends, and best practices, including developments in AI infrastructure, cloud\-native technologies, and F5 Distributed Cloud.
* Contribute to the development of internal knowledge base, methodologies, and best practices related to F5 Inc. solutions (including Distributed Cloud) in modern application architectures.
* Troubleshoot complex technical issues related to F5 deployments, potentially within Kubernetes environments, those supporting AI workloads, or utilizing F5 Distributed Cloud.
* Potentially mentor and guide junior team members.
* Contribute to thought leadership activities such as white papers, blog posts, presentations, and participation in industry forums, potentially including Mainstage Keynotes.
* Collaborate with Product Management and Engineering teams to provide field feedback and support the introduction of new F5 products and features to the market.
* Lead and track Proof of Concepts (PoCs) with customers, ensuring successful technical validation and alignment with business requirements.


**What You’ll Bring:**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering or a related field, or equivalent level of experience
* Minimum of 15\+ years of experience in designing and implementing network or application delivery solutions, with a strong focus on F5 Inc. is preferred.
* Deep technical expertise in F5 BIG\-IP platform (LTM, GTM, APM, AWAF), ideally NGINX, and familiarity with F5 Distributed Cloud Services is a plus.
* Strong understanding of networking protocols (TCP/IP, HTTP, DNS, etc.) and security principles.
* Experience with cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) and Kubernetes is highly desirable.
* Familiarity with concepts related to AI, including AI Factories, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), and AI Gateways.
* Proficiency in scripting languages (e.g., Python, Ansible) for automation.
* Experience with Application\-to\-Application (A2A) concepts and familiarity with Anthropic's Model Context Protocol (MCP) is a plus.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively communicate technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences, including experience with Mainstage Keynotes.
* Proven ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Relevant F5 certifications (e.g., F5 Certified! Technology Specialist) are highly advantageous.
* Direct experience deploying or securing AI/ML applications is a bonus.
* Experience with F5 Distributed Cloud in customer deployments is a plus.
* Experience with infrastructure\-as\-code (IaC) tools like Terraform is preferred.
* Knowledge of other applications, delivery and security technologies.
* Experience in a consulting or professional services environment.
* Demonstrated contributions to thought leadership in the application delivery or security space, including Mainstage Keynotes.
* Experience providing feedback to Product and Engineering teams on product direction.


 The Job Description is intended to be a general representation of the responsibilities and requirements of the job. However, the description may not be all\-inclusive, and responsibilities and requirements are subject to change.

**@myworkday.com)** 
**.**

title: Field Application Lead Engineer
description:
**WHAT YOU DO AT AMD CHANGES EVERYTHING**
 At AMD, our mission is to build great products that accelerate next\-generation computing experiences—from AI and data centers, to PCs, gaming and embedded systems. Grounded in a culture of innovation and collaboration, we believe real progress comes from bold ideas, human ingenuity and a shared passion to create something extraordinary. When you join AMD, you’ll discover the real differentiator is our culture. We push the limits of innovation to solve the world’s most important challenges—striving for execution excellence, while being direct, humble, collaborative, and inclusive of diverse perspectives. Join us as we shape the future of AI and beyond.
 **Together, we advance your career.**
 The Field Application Engineer position will be the technical interface for AMD’s embedded products with embedded customers in the INDIA region. As an Engineer, the role will be responsible for technical support for AMD’s embedded products, particularly FPGA and embedded x86 products. In this position, the individual will help AMD drive a new era of embedded computing by engaging with large INDIA end customers to demonstrate how AMD technology can be used to address the needs of their business. The role will provide technical support for AMD’s embedded pipeline with a special focus on pre\-sales and development support activity as opportunities transition from opportunity to deployment. Building confidence with key customer influencers and overcoming technical objections will be critical for success in the role. Post\-sales technical support is also required as the account encounters technical issues. The role will be expected to handle technical escalations that may occur and accelerate resolutions. The Engineer must have a strong technical knowledge base and skill\-set but be equally effective in communication with both customers and internal AMD stakeholders. Must be proficient in troubleshooting in embedded platform, system and module\-level design evaluations \& developing reference designs.
   

  

**The Primary Focus Of The FAE Will Be To**
* Develop technical relationships with target end customer accounts
* Win new embedded opportunities at end customers by establishing technical solutions based on AMD technology
* Work with AMD internal teams across AMD Business Units to build technical presentations and documentation to be delivered in the field
* Deliver technical presentations and sales pitches to influence new AMD sales with customers and partners.


 This position will require a broad technical understanding of embedded applications, especially in the communications segment. The position may require specialized knowledge of microprocessor and FPGA architectures, embedded knowledge including operating systems, BIOS \& firmware is a plus.
   

  

**JOB REQUIREMENTS \& Desired Skills/Exeperience**
* The preferred candidate should have a combination of relevant academic and professional experience. The minimum qualifications associated with this position are Bachelor Degree in Electrical or Computer Engineering with 10\+ years of experience, or advanced degree with 8\+ years of experience.
* Solid hands\-on experience with Vivado Design Suite and/or ISE
* Deep level knowledge of FPGA architecture
* Familiarity with various protocols and interfaces like Ethernet, PCIe, DDR etc
* Must demonstrate excellent problem\-solving skills and the ability to manage complex problems involving multi\-disciplined, cross\-functional teams
* High energy, results driven mentality with strong people/leadership skills.
* This position requires an individual with excellent organizational and communication skills with a good balance of hardware, architecture and software expertise. Must be a team player with excellent collaborative skills and superior written and oral communication skills

title: Partner Engineer, Google Cloud, GSI
description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following:
 **Bengaluru, Karnataka, India; Hyderabad, Telangana, India; Gurugram, Haryana, India** 
 .
 **Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 10 years of experience with cloud native architecture in a partner management or support role.
* Experience with cloud engineering, on\-premise engineering, virtualization, or containerization platforms.
* Experience engaging with, and presenting to, technical stakeholders and executive leaders.
* Experience translating customer objectives into Cloud solutions across multiple domains.
* Experience in managing GSI or other channel partners as a technical alliance lead or engineer.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* Experience managing multiple stakeholders, and working cross\-functionally, in a collaborative environment.
* Experience building business partnerships with partners and customers in an architecture or solution delivery role.
* Excellent communication skills, with experience conducting partner technical engagements.


**About The Job**
 When leading companies choose Google Cloud, it's a huge win for spreading the power of cloud computing globally. Once educational institutions, government agencies, and other businesses sign on to use Google Cloud products, you come in to facilitate making their work more productive, mobile, and collaborative. You listen and deliver what is most helpful for the customer. You assist fellow sales Googlers by problem\-solving key technical issues for our customers. You liaise with the product marketing management and engineering teams to stay on top of industry trends and devise enhancements to Google Cloud products.
   

  

 As a Global System Integrators (GSI) Partner Engineer, you will partner with GSI Partner development and Sales teams to differentiate Google Cloud to our GSI partners. You will serve as the GSI partner’s primary technical partner and trusted advisor, engaging in technical\-led conversations to understand their business issues. You will troubleshoot technical questions and roadblocks, engage in proofs\-of\-concepts and demos, and use your expertise to architect cross\-pillar cloud solutions that solve these business challenges. You will drive the technical win with the GSI Partner and assist to define the delivery and consumption plans. You will use your acumen and presentation skills to engage with technical and business leaders, and persuasively present practical and useful solutions on Google Cloud.
   

  

 You will focus on identifying, pursuing, and winning new business workloads and driving penetration within existing ones as a technical generalist, spanning infrastructure modernization, application modernization, data analytics and more. You will blend sales prowess, market knowledge and direct technical engagement to prove the value of the Google Cloud portfolio.Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Develop and own the GSI partner technical strategy, participating in planning and supporting targeted sales motions.
* Combine sales, programming, and solutions architecture expertise to prove the value of Google Cloud Platform across the portfolio through assisting and guiding the GSI partner to develop and deliver complex demos, pilots and in\-depth workshops.
* Architect cross\-pillar solutions, drive technical wins, and define initial delivery plans for customers with GSI partners; continue to lead the technical engagement in the solution phase.
* Plan and support the GSI Partner in building, developing and enhancing their Google Cloud practice.
* Be the technical point\-of\-contact for GSI partner for product and solution enquires, working in conjunction with Product and Support specialists within Google Cloud platform (GCP).


 Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

title: Sr. Application Engineer I
description:
**Job Description**
**Build your best future with the Johnson Controls team**
 As a global leader in smart, healthy and sustainable buildings, our mission is to reimagine the performance of buildings to serve people, places and the planet. Join a winning team that enables you to build your best future! Our teams are uniquely positioned to support a multitude of industries across the globe. You will have the opportunity to develop yourself through meaningful work projects and learning opportunities. We strive to provide our employees with an experience, focused on supporting their physical, financial, and emotional wellbeing.
   

  

 We are a
 **Great Place To Work\-Certified** 
 organization. Become a member of the Johnson Controls family and thrive in an empowering company culture where your voice and ideas will be heard – your next great opportunity is just a few clicks away!
   

  

**What We Offer**
* Competitive salary
* Paid vacation/holidays/sick time
* On the job/cross training opportunities
* Encouraging and collaborative team environment
* Dedication to safety through our Zero Harm policy


**What You Will Do**
 The primary responsibility for this role is to support pre\-sales engineering for Fire Detection System global projects as per country specific standards. Basic knowledge about bill of material preparation, cost estimation to come up with competitive bid. Follow processes, maintain required quality standards and on time deliveries to ensure customer satisfaction.
   

  

**How You Will Do It**

* Creation of bill of material, selection of Fire Alarm Panels, Controllers, Field Devices, Software Identification, Network connection, Cable Type and Length Calculations related to Fire Detection System.
* Preparation of Costing Sheet including Preliminaries and other costs, Cost comparison charts, Checklist, Technical Write\-up, Block Diagram, Deviation Chart etc.
* Ensure quality assurance, defect free deliverables, on time deliveries and customer satisfaction.
* Escalate issues in the right time, so as not to affect the project delivery schedule; any escalations with respect to scope\-creep must be clearly backed up with evidences.
* Keep operational parameters at desired level for all assigned projects.
* Ensure timesheet compliance with respect to entry and review for self and team.
* Weekly/Monthly customer reporting for project progress.
* Active participation in organization employee engagement initiatives


**What We Look For**
* BE (Instrumentation / Electrical / Electronics / Electronics \& Communication).
* Strong knowledge of Fire Detection System (Fire Alarm, VESDA, Linear Heat Detection, Fireman Intercom, Detection part of Gas Suppression System, Gas Detection etc)
* Knowledge on Simplex \& Zettler fire alarm product along with Xtralis, Securiton \& Wagner product for Aspirating Smoke Detection system
* Simplex \& VESDA certifications will have added advantage
* Expertise in Fire Alarm Code and Guidelines. Should be familiar with local code requirement for Singapore, Hong Kong \& Malaysia region.
* Proficient in AutoCAD, MS Office tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio, etc.), Blue Beam
* Knowledge of different types of network protocols like BACNet, Modbus, and other protocols.
* Should have good experience for subcon/vendor engagement keeping close


 co\-ordination with procurement
   

  

* Must be a quick learner, team player \& should have a keen eye for problem solving.
* Proficient in written and verbal communication.
* Ability to demonstrate good leadership skills.


**Preferred**
 10\+ years of relevant experience in Fire Detection System’s Desing and Estimation.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer IRC302348
description:
**Description**
**About the Role \& Team**
 We are seeking a Forward\-Deployed AI Architect to help our enterprise customers radically accelerate and modernize their software delivery lifecycle. In this elite, high\-impact role, you will embed directly with customer engineering teams to prove the value of AI\-led engineering through hands\-on architecture, agentic workflows, and measurable delivery outcomes.
   

  

 This role is designed for senior architects and builders who sit at the intersection of core enterprise software architecture and cutting\-edge AI engineering. You will help customers transition from traditional, ticket\-bound Scrum cycles toward intent\-driven, increasingly autonomous delivery models where AI tools, agents, and human governance seamlessly turn business intent into production\-ready software.
   

  

**Requirements**
**Candidate Profile: Qualifications \& Experience**
**Must\-Have Attributes**
 – Experience: 11\+ years of proven experience across software engineering, architecture, product/platform engineering, or solution architecture, backed by a strong track record of product\-side delivery.
   

  

 – SDLC Mastery: Deep, foundational understanding of enterprise software architecture, DevSecOps pipelines, Agile/Scrum frameworks, and the broader product lifecycle.
   

  

 – Hands\-on AI Fluency: Direct, practical fluency with AI development tools, IDE\-based AI assistants, agentic workflows, and AI\-enabled software delivery. You must possess the ability to build, evaluate, and deeply explain working AI solutions.
   

  

 – Modern AI Tech Stack: Experience leveraging tools and frameworks such as Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, GitHub Copilot, LangChain, AutoGen, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, MCP (Model Context Protocol), RAG, and vector databases.
   

  

 – Hands on in Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), Vector Databases, Evaluation Frameworks, Prompt Engineering, Tool Calling, Function Calling, Multi\-agent orchestration, AI Observability
   

  

**Good\-to\-Have Skills**
 – Customer\-Facing Excellence: Prior experience in high\-touch, customer\-facing technical roles (e.g., Forward\-Deployed Engineer, Principal Solutions Architect, Field Engineer, or Pre\-Sales Engineering Leader).
   

  

 – AI Governance \& Security: A strong grasp of AI governance models, human\-in\-the\-loop controls, responsible AI frameworks, observability, and production readiness for AI\-enabled enterprise systems.
   

  

 Job responsibilities
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Client Engagement \& Strategic Architecture


 – Identify AI Opportunities: Work directly with customer engineering, product, architecture, and executive teams to diagnose SDLC bottlenecks and map out high\-value areas for AI\-led acceleration.
   

  

 – Design \& Build Proofs of Concept: Act as a hands\-on builder to design, develop, and deliver working proofs utilizing modern AI engineering tools, agentic workflows, and automation frameworks.
   

  

 – Lead the Intent\-Driven Transition: Guide clients away from rigid, manual sprint mechanics toward fluid, intent\-driven delivery loops capable of autonomously generating plans, code, tests, documentation, and validation artifacts.
   

  

  

* Value Measurement \& Executive Alignment


 – Quantify AI Impact: Define, measure, and report on hard engineering acceleration outcomes, including reduced cycle times, faster story\-to\-code conversion, improved automated testing, and accelerated code reviews.
   

  

 – Technical \& Executive Presentation: Communicate complex technical approaches, agentic architectures, proof results, and long\-term adoption strategies to both engineering teams and C\-level stakeholders.
   

  

 What we offer
   

  

**Exciting Projects:** 
 We focus on industries like High\-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.
   

  

**Collaborative Environment:** 
 You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!
   

  

**Work\-Life Balance:** 
 GlobalLogic prioritizes work\-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 Our dedicated Learning \& Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.
   

  

**Excellent Benefits:** 
 We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.
   

  

**Fun Perks:** 
 We want you to love where you work, which is why we host sports events, cultural activities, offer food on subsidies rates, Corporate parties. Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!
   

  

**About GlobalLogic**
 GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward\-thinking companies. Since 2000, we’ve been at the forefront of the digital revolution – helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.

title: Sr. Consultant
description:
**Opentext \- The Information Company**
 OpenText is a global leader in information management, where innovation, creativity, and collaboration are the key components of our corporate culture. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to partner with the most highly regarded companies in the world, tackle complex issues, and contribute to projects that shape the future of digital transformation.
   

  

**AI\-First. Future\-Driven. Human\-Centered.**
 At OpenText, AI is at the heart of everything we do—powering innovation, transforming work, and empowering digital knowledge workers. We're hiring talent that AI can't replace to help us shape the future of information management. Join us.
   

  

**Your Impact**
 OpenText enables the digital world as the global leader in Enterprise Information Management, both on\-cloud and off\-cloud. We embrace all things digital and are committed to being the Best Place to Work for our Employees in over 140 locations around the world.We obsess over our customers to ensure they are wildly successful in embracing the Digital World. Our customers entrust us with their most valuable information, we need to be their most trusted partner. What we do, we do well. What we create, we do purposefully to impact the world. If you believe in this and are enthusiastic about enabling the Digital World, then let OpenText turn your career vision into reality.
   

  

**What The Role Offers**
 The Open Text Professional Services team is comprised of more than 3,000 consultants who function as trusted advisors, managing long\-lasting relationships with more than 100,000 customers around the world. They are responsible for the delivery of business solutions from pre\-sales to post implementation. Our teams of experts help organizations solve issues, create value, improve business performance, and work more effectively in an increasingly digital world.
   

  

 As a Sr. Consultant at OpenText Professional Services team you will play a key role in creating and delivering strategic, impactful, and integrated digital solutions for clients using a combination of OpenText technologies. This role offers an opportunity to leverage your expertise in OpenText xECM configuration, knowledge of SAP business processes and integration to deliver seamless solutions that bridge the world of information and business application.
   

  

**What You Need To Succeed**
* Engaging with enterprise architects, business, and IT stakeholders of client to understand their business processes, technology landscape and functional requirements in order to define integrated digital solutions for their business problems.
* Planning and conducting business workshops with business and IT stakeholders of the client to elicit and document business and technical requirements for complex digital solutions.
* Architecting the OpenText solution, combining xECM functionalities \& SAP Integration, based on client’s functional and non\-functional requirements, and considering current state and future roadmap of the client.
* Creating comprehensive documentation that supports the implementation and evolution of the solution through all stages of SDLC \- Business Requirements, Functional Specification/Solution Blueprint, High\-level and Low\-level Design, Deployment and Configuration guides etc.
* Working collaboratively with program/project management team within OpenText and on\-client side to assist in task planning \& assignment for solution implementation, acceptance, and rollout.
* Collaborating with architects/developers/testers as a project team to implement the solution as per the proposed design with utmost quality.
* Assessing the current solution and impact of proposed changes to provide recommendations for release changes \& migrations.
* Basic configuration of the OpenText xECM components and Integration with SAP
* Analyzing and debugging of complex functional, design and implementation issues related to the solution and preparation of RCA. Mentoring and guiding technical architects and senior developers within the team with professional and technical advice.


**One Last Thing**
* Graduate/Postgraduate with 5\+ years of professional experience in designing medium to complex digital enterprise solutions in area of xECM for SAP.
* Excellent consulting skills – engagement, articulation, elicitation and influencing.
* Excellent customer\-facing skills \- stakeholder management, relationship building and negotiation – with strategic focus.
* Software configuration and programming knowledge, e.g., ABAP Programming, Data Dictionary, OOABAP, Fiori \& Development RICEF objects
* Project experience in the SAP environment, SAP HCM/SuccessFactors, SAP Hybris C4C and/or Salesforce is additional advantage.
* Prior experience in SAP S/4 HANA and Fiori/UI5 is an additional advantage.
* Excellent verbal and written communication and presentations skills
* Willingness to travel within India and globally.


 OpenText's efforts to build an inclusive work environment go beyond simply complying with applicable laws. Our Employment Equity and Diversity Policy provides direction on maintaining a working environment that is inclusive of everyone, regardless of culture, national origin, race, color, gender, gender identification, sexual orientation, family status, age, veteran status, disability, religion, or other basis protected by applicable laws.

title: Edtech Repesentative (4.5 lpa)
description:
**Company Description** 
 AL Fahad Global Enterprises is an emerging organization focused on building innovative solutions and services for the education and technology sectors. The company emphasizes professional growth, performance\-based recognition, and a collaborative work culture. Team members are encouraged to learn continuously and contribute ideas that improve products and services. AL Fahad Global Enterprises offers opportunities to work with diverse stakeholders and impact learners and institutions. The organization aims to expand its presence in key markets such as Bengaluru, creating long\-term career paths for driven professionals.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Edtech Representative (4\.5 LPA) is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Bengaluru. The individual in this position will connect with schools, colleges, coaching centers, and individual learners to promote the company’s education technology products and services. Daily activities include meeting potential clients, conducting product demonstrations, explaining features and benefits, handling queries, and supporting onboarding and basic training. The role involves managing leads, maintaining accurate records in CRM tools, following up on prospects, and working toward monthly and quarterly sales and adoption targets. The Edtech Representative will collaborate closely with internal teams to share market feedback, refine offerings, and ensure a positive and professional customer experience from first contact through post\-sale support.
   

**Qualifications**
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain edtech solutions clearly to diverse audiences.
* Customer relationship skills, including confidence in client meetings, objection handling, and follow\-up management.
* Basic sales and marketing skills, such as lead generation, pitching, negotiation, and understanding of the education market.

title: Field Application Engineer, Verification
description:
Alternate Job Titles
   

  

* Field Application Engineer, Verification
* Senior Applications Engineer, RTL Signoff
* Customer Success Engineer, Verification Solutions
* Technical Application Engineer, Design Verification
* Solutions Engineer, Verification and Low Power


 We Are
   

  

 Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
   

  

 You Are
   

  

 You have spent years deep in RTL verification flows and you have learned that the hardest problems are rarely the ones in the datasheet. They show up three weeks before tapeout when a CDC violation surfaces in a corner case no one thought to model, or when a low power domain interaction breaks in ways the testbench never caught. You live for those moments because solving them well is what keeps chips from respinning.
   

  

 You are equally comfortable reading SystemVerilog assertions, walking a customer through a SpyGlass run, and sitting with an R\&D team to explain why a methodology needs to flex for a real design. You do not wait for someone to hand you a script. You write it, test it, and then show the customer how to own it themselves.
   

  

 Working across time zones does not faze you. Neither does jumping into a customer war room when a project is stuck. You know that adoption is not about features, it is about trust, and trust comes from showing up, understanding the problem, and delivering something that actually moves the schedule forward. At Synopsys, you will work with semiconductor teams building the chips that power everything, and what you enable will matter.
   

  

 What You'll Be Doing
   

  

* Work directly with semiconductor design teams across the region to deploy and optimize Synopsys verification solutions including VC SpyGlass, VCS, VC LP, VC Formal, and Verdi
* Debug complex RTL signoff issues in customer designs, CDC violations, lint errors, RDC problems, low power UPF conflicts, and formal property failures, and turn those into repeatable methodology improvements
* Partner with Synopsys R\&D and product validation teams to develop new flows, reproduce customer issues, and drive tool enhancements that solve real tapeout blockers
* Lead technical engagements during critical project phases, onsite or remote, ensuring customers hit their verification milestones and tapeout schedules
* Gather requirements from customer feedback and design challenges, translate them into flow improvements, and work with product teams to prioritize and track delivery
* Coordinate with account managers and technical account managers to shape customer strategies, drive tool adoption, and support business growth across your accounts
* Train customer engineering teams on verification methodologies, tool usage, and best practices that reduce verification cycle time and improve signoff quality


 The Impact You Will Have
   

  

* Enable customers to close CDC, lint, and low power signoff weeks or months faster by deploying the right methodology at the right time in their flow
* Reduce customer respins by catching critical RTL issues early, before they reach gate\-level or silicon
* Drive adoption of Synopsys verification tools across new projects and teams, expanding footprint and deepening technical relationships with key accounts
* Influence Synopsys product roadmaps by surfacing real customer pain points and working with R\&D to deliver features that matter
* Build repeatable flows and reference methodologies that scale across multiple customer projects and design teams
* Strengthen customer confidence in Synopsys solutions by being the engineer they call when something breaks and needs to get fixed now
* Contribute to the success of chips powering AI, automotive, mobile, and cloud infrastructure by ensuring verification does not become the bottleneck


 What You'll Need
   

  

* BE/BTech/ME/MTech in Electronics Engineering, Computer Science, or Microelectronics with 3\-5 years of hands\-on industry experience in ASIC design or verification
* Strong command of VHDL, Verilog, and SystemVerilog RTL, and a solid understanding of ASIC design and verification flows from RTL to tapeout
* Proven experience with RTL signoff flows including linting, Clock Domain Crossing (CDC), Reset Domain Crossing (RDC), and property checking using static and formal verification tools
* Hands\-on work with low power verification techniques using UPF or CPF, and experience debugging power intent issues in real designs
* Exposure to simulation and verification methodologies including directed tests, constrained random testing, assertions, coverage\-driven verification, and gate\-level simulation (GLS)
* Working knowledge of Synopsys EDA tools such as VC SpyGlass, VCS, VC LP, VC Formal, FishTail, or Verdi is a strong plus
* Comfort working in ambiguity, you can take a vague customer problem, ask the right questions, and turn it into a clear technical plan


 Who You Are
   

  

* You can walk into a customer meeting, listen to a verification challenge, and sketch out a solution approach on the whiteboard that the team actually believes in
* You are the kind of engineer who does not just report a tool issue, you create a minimal reproducible test case, propose a workaround, and follow up until it is resolved
* Working across global teams and time zones does not slow you down, you coordinate effectively, keep stakeholders aligned, and do not let details fall through the cracks
* You know how to explain a complex CDC violation or formal proof failure to a design lead in a way that makes sense without oversimplifying the technical reality
* You build relationships by being reliable, when you say you will deliver a flow or a debug session, it happens
* You are curious about what is coming next in chip design, AI workloads, automotive safety, advanced nodes, and you want to be part of enabling it


 The Team You'll Be Part Of
   

  

 You will join the Customer Success Group, a global team that partners directly with semiconductor companies to solve high\-value verification and design problems. The team works closely with R\&D, product validation, account management, and technical account managers to drive adoption of Synopsys solutions and ensure customer projects succeed through tapeout. You will be part of a regional applications engineering team supporting customers across India, collaborating with engineers worldwide, and contributing to methodologies that scale across the business.
   

  

 Rewards and Benefits
   

  

 We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non\-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

You will define and scale productized security solutions that help organizations manage risk, detect and respond to threats, and strengthen cyber resilience—without the complexity and long timelines of traditional large enterprise programs.

title: Customer Experience Manager
description:
At Kapture CX, we are looking for a
 **Customer Experience Manager** 
 in our Customer experience team.
   

  

**About Kapture CX**
 Founded in Bengaluru in 2014,
 **Kapture CX** 
 began as an enterprise customer support software company and has evolved into an
 **AI\-first Agentic Operating System for Enterprises** 
 .
   

  

 Kapture helps enterprises scale AI execution while keeping humans in control. Its
 **AgentOS platform** 
 enables enterprises to deploy, orchestrate, monitor, and optimize AI agents across critical business workflows — including
 **customer support, sales, collections, and claims** 
 .
   

  

 Kapture’s AI agents can execute workflows end\-to\-end across
 **voice, chat, email, messaging, and social channels** 
 , with human intervention built in wherever judgment, empathy, or decision\-making is required.
   

  

**What is this role all about?**
 As a
 **Customer Experience Manager** 
**,** 
 you become the trusted technical advisor for our clients. You ensure customers successfully onboard, integrate, and scale on Kapture’s platform while proactively solving complex technical challenges and driving long\-term value.
   

  

**Sounds interesting?**
 Here’s a more detailed description of what you will do in this role:
   

  

* You will lead client onboarding and integrations, working hands\-on with APIs, JSON payloads, and tools like Postman and cURL to ensure seamless adoption.
* You will own technical support and escalations, diagnosing issues using logs, Kafka, Grafana, Sentry, and collaborating closely with engineering and product teams to drive fast resolutions.
* You will build strong, trusted client relationships by acting as a technical advisor and advocate, translating complex concepts into clear, actionable insights.
* You will proactively identify optimization opportunities, conduct platform health checks, and recommend technical strategies to help clients maximize ROI.
* You will document issues, resolutions, and RCAs while sharing feedback and insights to influence product improvements and best practices.


 This is a
 **Mumbai\-based role** 
 . We work five days a week from the office, as we believe in\-person interactions fuel innovation and agility.
   

  

**What does success look like in this role?**
 You consistently deliver smooth client experiences, resolve issues before they escalate, and help customers fully leverage Kapture’s platform to achieve measurable business impact.
   

  

**What would make you a good fit for this role?**
**Here Are The Basic Requirements**
* You have strong hands\-on experience with API integrations and system troubleshooting.
* You are comfortable working directly with enterprise clients and managing multiple priorities.
* You can collaborate effectively with engineering, product, sales, and support teams.
* You enjoy solving complex technical problems in fast\-paced environments.


**What are the most critical skills for this role?**
* You can debug issues by inspecting logs, tracing errors, and identifying root causes quickly.
* You are proficient with modern tech stacks and monitoring tools like Kafka, Grafana, and Sentry (or similar).
* You communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* You take ownership and think proactively about client success and platform optimization.


**You Will Have An Advantage If You**
* You have prior experience working with CRM platforms like Salesforce or HubSpot.
* You are comfortable working with SQL/NoSQL databases and understanding data flows.
* You have exposure to chatbot technologies or AI\-driven automation platforms.
* You enjoy creating clear documentation, troubleshooting guides, and RCAs.


**Why should you be interested?**
**Here’s What You Will Gain From This Role**
* An opportunity to work at the intersection of technology, clients, and business impact.
* Hands\-on exposure to large\-scale CX automation and AI\-powered platforms.
* Collaboration with highly skilled product, engineering, and customer success teams.
* Strong growth opportunities in a fast\-scaling global SaaS organization, along with competitive compensation and performance\-linked rewards.

title: AI Architect Senior Advisor
description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
 Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
   

  

 AI Architect Senior Advisor
   

  

 The Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) is a senior, customer\-facing practitioner who connects customer needs, measurable business outcomes, and technology solutions. Working directly within customer environments, the FDE partners with business and technical stakeholders to understand complex challenges, reduce ambiguity, make opportunities tangible, and establish a credible path from idea to production value.
   

  

 The FDE combines depth in a relevant specialist discipline with broad knowledge of company and partner platforms, products, accelerators, and reusable assets. They apply domain context, technical judgement, and commercial awareness to identify high\-impact opportunities and determine the most appropriate route to the customer outcome, including bespoke AI delivery, product capabilities, platform or infrastructure services, and reuse of existing assets.
   

  

 The FDE acts as the persistent outcome thread between customer stakeholders and internal engineering, product, architecture, delivery, and operations teams. They shape validated opportunities into delivery\-ready work, remain connected through implementation and adoption, and use customer feedback and production evidence to guide improvement without replacing the accountable production delivery or managed service teams.
   

  

 Combining domain understanding, technical credibility, strong client emotional intelligence, and outcome leadership, the FDE operates independently in ambiguous enterprise environments and is trusted to lead complex customer engagements. The role requires hands\-on problem solving, sound judgement, effective stakeholder influence, and the ability to orchestrate the right capabilities while maintaining focus on measurable customer value and scalable delivery.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Partner with customers and stakeholders to understand business objectives, workflow challenges, desired outcomes, and the measures that will demonstrate success.
* Lead discovery, assessment, and solution\-shaping activities that translate ambiguous business needs into clear, prioritised opportunities.
* Establish outcome hypotheses, success measures, key assumptions, and customer ownership before recommending material investment or progression.
* Create or direct rapid prototypes, proof points, experiments, and demonstrations that test the assumptions most critical to value and feasibility.
* Assess solution feasibility across AI, data, integration, architecture, security, privacy, Responsible AI, operational readiness, and cost considerations.
* Shape validated opportunities into production\-ready work, including target workflow, architecture direction, prioritised backlog, dependencies, acceptance direction, estimates, and mobilisation requirements.
* Build trusted relationships with technical, business, and senior stakeholders, providing clear guidance and constructive challenge throughout customer engagements.
* Collaborate across engineering, architecture, product, delivery, operations, industry, transformation, and account teams to orchestrate the capabilities required for successful outcomes.
* Analyze and resolve complex business, technical, and operational challenges using sound judgement, evidence, and structured problem\-solving.
* Identify high\-value use cases by combining domain context, stakeholder insight, technology capability, feasibility, and measurable business impact.
* Determine the most appropriate delivery route, including AI Studio, company products, AI Factory, transformation services, partner capabilities, reuse, further validation, or stop.
* Maintain the outcome thread as work moves into delivery by validating major decisions, assumptions, user feedback, adoption needs, and continued alignment to the intended value.
* Capture field feedback, implementation learning, defects, feature requests, customer signals, and reusable patterns from customer engagements.
* Contribute to internal IP, accelerators, reference architectures, implementation playbooks, reusable assets, and continuous improvement of the Forward Deployed and AI Studio methods.
* Provide guidance, mentoring, and knowledge sharing to FDE Candidates and delivery practitioners to strengthen capability and successful outcomes.
* Role may require working at customer sites, company offices, or hybrid delivery locations depending on engagement needs.


**Knowledge and Attributes**
* Strong domain awareness with the ability to understand customer workflows, value drivers, operating constraints, industry context, and relevant success measures.
* Strong technical credibility across enterprise solution architecture, engineering practices, data, integration, cloud platforms, and production technology delivery.
* Applied understanding of artificial intelligence, generative AI, agentic systems, RAG, automation, model and tool integration, and emerging AI technologies.
* Understanding of production AI considerations including evaluation, security, privacy, Responsible AI, observability, AgentOps, FinOps, resilience, and operational readiness.
* Strong client emotional intelligence, consulting, stakeholder management, facilitation, and communication skills, with the ability to build trust quickly in senior customer environments.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, critical\-thinking, experimentation, and evidence\-based decision\-making capabilities.
* Deep working expertise in at least one relevant specialist area such as AI engineering, architecture, industry, transformation, product, data, or AI infrastructure.
* Broad knowledge of relevant company and partner platforms, products, accelerators, implementation methods, and reusable assets, and when to apply them.
* Ability to learn and apply domain context quickly, including processes, terminology, regulations, data flows, user roles, constraints, and business metrics.
* Commercial awareness to connect technical choices with business value, risk, cost, time to value, adoption, and the appropriate delivery model.
* Strong outcome leadership, including the ability to define measurable outcomes, surface assumptions, prioritise evidence, and drive Build, Iterate, Route, or Stop decisions.
* Strong reuse and product\-feedback mindset, including the ability to distinguish customer\-specific needs from patterns and improvements that should be scaled.
* Ability to communicate complex concepts clearly with domain, business, executive, engineering, architecture, and operational stakeholders using the appropriate level of detail.
* Ability to work independently, manage ambiguity, challenge constructively, and balance business, technical, commercial, and operational priorities.
* Ability to influence technical and non\-technical stakeholders across multiple organizational levels without relying on formal authority.
* Strong collaboration, relationship\-building, mentoring, and knowledge\-sharing skills, with a bias toward creating customer and practice capability rather than individual dependency.


**Required Qualifications And Certifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Science, Business Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
* Relevant industry certifications in cloud technologies, solution architecture, data, artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, agile delivery, industry domains, or related disciplines are beneficial. Certifications support but do not replace demonstrated FDE capability and accreditation.


**Required Experience**
* Typically 8\+ years of relevant experience in software or AI engineering, solution architecture, consulting, customer engineering, product engineering, industry transformation, technology delivery, or related disciplines, with equivalent demonstrated depth considered.
* Significant experience working directly with enterprise customers and building credibility with business, technical, and senior stakeholders.
* Experience independently leading discovery, problem framing, solution shaping, or complex customer workstreams in ambiguous environments.
* Experience creating or directing prototypes, proof points, technical experiments, or working solutions to validate customer and technology assumptions.
* Experience shaping and delivering enterprise technology solutions involving architecture, data, integration, security, deployment, and production constraints.
* Experience applying domain or functional context to customer workflows, constraints, KPIs, value drivers, and solution decisions.
* Experience connecting technology decisions to measurable customer outcomes, adoption, business value, risk reduction, operational efficiency, or customer experience.
* Experience collaborating with product, engineering, platform, industry, transformation, delivery, and business teams to determine the right solution and delivery route.
* Experience evaluating build, buy, reuse, product, partner, and platform options pragmatically rather than defaulting to bespoke implementation.
* Experience operating within complex enterprise environments and navigating dependencies across technology, data, governance, operations, and customer organizations.
* Experience operating independently, exercising sound judgement, influencing decisions, and maintaining momentum through uncertainty and changing priorities.
* Experience capturing reusable patterns, field feedback, lessons learned, methodologies, accelerators, or other assets that improve future delivery.
* Experience providing guidance, mentoring, peer review, or knowledge sharing to colleagues and developing practitioners.


**About NTT DATA**
 NTT DATA is a $30\+ billion trusted global innovator of business and technology services. We serve 75% of the Fortune Global 100 and are committed to helping clients innovate, optimize and transform for long\-term success. We invest over $3\.6 billion each year in R\&D to help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have diverse experts in more than 50 countries and a robust partner ecosystem of established and start\-up companies. Our services include business and technology consulting, data and artificial intelligence, industry solutions, as well as the development, implementation and management of applications, infrastructure, and connectivity. We are also one of the leading providers of digital and AI infrastructure in the world. NTT DATA is part of NTT Group and headquartered in Tokyo.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
 NTT DATA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer with a global culture that embraces diversity. We are committed to providing an environment free of unfair discrimination and harassment. We do not discriminate based on age, race, colour, gender, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, disability, pregnancy, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected category. Join our growing global team and accelerate your career with us. Apply today.
