title: Technical Account Consultant - Benefits
description:
******About Rippling******
 Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.
   

  

 Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.
   

  

 Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.
   

  

 We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.
   

  

******About Rippling******
 Rippling is the first way for businesses to manage all of their HR \& IT—payroll, benefits, computers, apps, and more—in one unified workforce platform.
   

  

 By connecting every workforce system to a single source of truth for employee data, businesses can automate all of the manual work they normally need to do to make employee changes. Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can just click a button and set up a new employee’s payroll, health insurance, work computer, and third\-party apps—like Slack, Zoom, and Office 365—all within 90 seconds.
   

  

 Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.2B from the world's top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Bedrock, and Greenoaks—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes (\#12 out of 500\)
   

  

******About The Role******
 You are the "Benefits Expert" for Rippling's customers.
   

  

 You’ll expertly navigate and and enable customers with Ripplings Benefits products, including Benadmin for the US and Canada, Flex Benefits, PEO, and HR Services. You’ll provide insightful guidance on best practices for benefits management, advocate thoughtfully for your customers' benefits needs, and build trusted relationships with HR/Benefits administrators. title: Corporate Strategy Manager (Consulting & Strategy)
description:
Organizations everywhere struggle under the crushing costs and complexities of “solutions” that promise to simplify their lives. To create a better experience for their customers and employees. To help them grow. Software is a choice that can make or break a business. Create better or worse experiences. Propel or throttle growth. Business software has become a blocker instead of ways to get work done.
   

  





**There’s another option. Freshworks. With a fresh vision for how the world works.**




 Freshworks Inc. builds uncomplicated service software that delivers exceptional employee and customer experiences. Our people\-first approach to AI eliminates friction, helping businesses reduce complexity, lower cost\-to\-serve, and deliver faster, more human support through enterprise\-grade yet easy\-to\-use CX and IT solutions. Nearly 75,000 companies, including Bridgestone, New Balance, Nucor, S\&P Global, and Sony Music, trust Freshworks to power their Employee Experience (EX) and Customer Experience (CX) operations.
   

  

  

  

**Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.**



**Job Description**

 Freshworks is looking for a Manager to join our global Corporate Strategy team and help shape some of the most important decisions facing the company.
   

  





 This is a high\-impact strategy role for someone who loves solving complex business problems but wants to get closer to the decisions, the executives making them, and the outcomes that follow.
   

  





 You'll work directly with Strategy leadership and senior executives on questions spanning AI, product strategy, pricing and monetization, GTM growth, market expansion, and strategic investments. One project might involve evaluating how we monetize a new AI capability; another could focus on where Freshworks should invest to accelerate growth or how we evolve our GTM strategy.
   

  





 The team operates with the rigor of a top strategy consulting firm, but with one important difference: we don't stop at the recommendation. We partner across Product, Sales, Finance, and Operations to help turn strategy into action and see the impact of the decisions we help shape.
   

  





**What You'll Do**




 • Own high\-priority strategic initiatives from initial question through recommendation and execution.
   

  

 • Tackle ambiguous company\-level problems, develop hypotheses, and create the analytical frameworks needed to answer them.
   

  

 • Evaluate growth opportunities across AI, product, GTM, pricing, market expansion, and strategic investments.
   

  

 • Build business cases, financial models, market assessments, and scenario analyses that inform investment and resource allocation decisions.
   

  

 • Partner directly with senior leaders across Product, Sales, Finance, and Operations to shape decisions and drive alignment.
   

  

 • Translate strategy into actionable plans and stay close to execution to understand what is working and where we need to adjust.
   

  

 • Develop executive and Board\-level narratives that distill complex analysis into clear choices and recommendations.
   

  

 • Bring an outside\-in perspective on the SaaS and AI landscape and help identify the strategic questions Freshworks should be asking next.
   

  

  

  




**Qualifications**

**What We're Looking For**




 • 4\-6\+ years of experience in management consulting, corporate strategy, or a combination of consulting and in\-house strategy experience;
 **experience from a top\-tier management consulting firm, particularly MBB (Mckinsey, Bain, BCG) is preferred**
  

 • Experience solving growth, product, GTM, pricing, market entry, or investment strategy problems
   

  

 • Exposure to SaaS, enterprise software, or technology businesses strongly preferred
   

  

 • Strong analytical and financial modeling skills with the ability to turn data into business insights and recommendations
   

  

 • Executive\-level communication skills and the ability to influence without authority
   

  

 • Comfortable moving between high\-level strategy and hands\-on analysis
   

  

 • Curious, low ego, and energized by ambiguity
   

  

 • Most importantly, you want to own the outcome, not just deliver the recommendation
   

  





**Why This Role**




 Freshworks is at an exciting point in its evolution. We're scaling a global SaaS business, expanding our enterprise presence, and navigating how AI changes the products we build, how we monetize them, and how our customers work.
   

  





 For someone coming from consulting, this is an opportunity to keep the parts of the job you love—complex problems, executive exposure, analytical rigor, and variety—while gaining something that's harder to get as an advisor: ownership.
   

  





 You'll see the decisions get made. You'll work alongside the teams responsible for executing them. And you'll have the opportunity to see whether the strategy actually worked.
   

  





 This is a highly visible individual contributor role with exposure to senior executives and the Board, and an opportunity to build a deep understanding of how a global SaaS company operates.
   

  

  

  




**Additional Information**

 At Freshworks, we have fostered an environment that enables everyone to find their true potential, purpose, and passion, welcoming colleagues of all backgrounds, genders, sexual orientations, religions, and ethnicities. We are committed to providing equal opportunity and believe that diversity in the workplace creates a more vibrant, richer environment that boosts the goals of our employees, communities, and business.
 **Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.**

description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*
 Job Category
   

  

 Customer Success
   

  

 Job Details
   

  

******About Salesforce******
 Salesforce is the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
   

  

 Ready to level\-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
   

  

****Job Description****
 The Commercial Architecture Lead ensures Professional Services deals are shaped correctly before we commit to the customer.
   

  

 This role owns the practical commercial logic behind scoping, estimation, SOW structure, risk, pricing assumptions, and delivery economics.
   

  

**The Focus Is Simple:**
 Help the field shape deals that are clear, executable, profitable, and easier to approve.
   

  

****What This Role Owns****
* Deal Qualification Rules


 Define when a ProServe opportunity is ready to be scoped and estimated.
   

  

**This Includes:**
* What information must be known before estimation starts
* When CoE review is required
* Which deals are too vague to estimate responsibly
* Which deals need Legal, RevRec, PS Ops, GDC, Practice, or Governance input


****Example:****
 If a customer asks for fixed fee but scope, data sources, integrations, or acceptance criteria are unclear, this role defines the required checks before the team proceeds.
   

  

* Commercial Model Guidance


 Create clear guidance with respective stakeholders on when to use:
   

  

* T\&M
* Fixed capacity
* Fixed fee
* Hybrid models
* Investment / discount structures


 This role helps teams avoid choosing a commercial model that creates delivery or margin risk later.
   

  

****Example:****
 Fixed fee may be acceptable for repeatable work with clear scope. It should not be the default for unclear, multi\-cloud, dependency\-heavy work.
   

  

* Estimation Guardrails


 Define the commercial assumptions that must be included in an estimate.
   

  

**This Includes:**
* Bid metrics
* Role mix
* Skill level
* Onshore / GDC mix
* Contingency logic
* Risk buffer
* Customer dependencies
* Assumptions and exclusions
* Margin thresholds


****Example:****
 If the estimate assumes GDC delivery, this role ensures the assumptions are realistic: right skills, timing, handoff model, and delivery readiness.
   

  

* SOW Commercial Quality


 Ensure SOWs are commercially clean before they move forward.
   

  

**Focus Areas:**
* Scope is clear
* Out\-of\-scope items are explicit
* Customer responsibilities are documented
* Acceptance criteria are defined where needed
* Payment milestones make sense
* Change control language is clear
* Commercial Risk Detection


 Build a system to identify common issues before the deal is signed.
   

  

**Risks To Catch:**
* Scope too broad
* Estimate too optimistic
* Fixed\-fee exposure
* Missing customer dependencies
* Underestimated data / integration work
* Non\-standard terms introduced late
* Delivery leader brought in too late
* Staffing model not executable
* Approval path unclear


**Practical Deliverables**
**This Role Should Create And Maintain:**
* Deal qualification checklist
* Commercial model decision tree
* Fixed\-fee readiness checklist
* Estimation assumptions checklist
* Margin / risk review checklist
* SOW commercial quality checklist
* Approval trigger guide
* Assumptions and exclusions library
* Commercial risk heatmap
* Standard guidance for T\&M, fixed capacity, fixed fee, and hybrid deals


**Key Partners**
 Sales Excellence
   

  

* Align on when ProServe should engage
* Improve deal qualification
* Reduce late\-stage sales escalations caused by unclear scope


 PS Operations
   

  

* Ensure deal structure can be booked, approved, staffed, and tracked correctly
* Avoid mismatches between SOW, approvals, and system setup


 Growth \& Offering
   

  

* Turn repeatable offerings into clear commercial models
* Define standard scope, pricing assumptions, and delivery boundaries


 GDC
   

  

* Validate offshore / onshore delivery assumptions
* Confirm skill availability and delivery feasibility


 Practices
   

  

* Confirm product\-specific effort drivers
* Validate assumptions for Data Cloud, Agentforce, MuleSoft, Industry Clouds, and multi\-cloud work


 Delivery Innovation \& Governance
   

  

* Align commercial guardrails with delivery risk controls
* Ensure governance focuses on real risk, not unnecessary process


 Legal / RevRec / Finance
   

  

* Define early triggers for legal terms, fixed fee, fixed capacity, milestone billing, and revenue recognition review


****What Success Looks Like****
* Fewer poorly shaped deals reach approval stage
* Fewer SOW rework cycles
* Fewer pricing / system mismatches
* Better estimate quality
* Better margin predictability
* Cleaner handoff to delivery
* Faster approvals because required inputs are clear upfront
* Field teams know which commercial path to take and when to escalate


****Minimum Qualifications****
* 10\+ years in professional services, services sales, deal shaping, solutioning, delivery, or services operations
* Strong understanding of scoping, estimation, SOWs, pricing assumptions, approvals, and delivery handoff
* Experience with T\&M, fixed capacity, fixed fee, and hybrid commercial models
* Ability to identify commercial risk before signature
* Experience working with Sales, Delivery, Operations, Legal, Finance, RevRec, GDC, and Practice teams
* Strong ability to turn messy deal experience into simple checklists, guardrails, and decision trees


**A Day in the Life**
 A typical day involves analyzing commercial patterns in recent deals, refining guardrails to prevent recurring issues, and guiding field teams on selecting the optimal commercial model for live opportunities. Responsibilities include validating assumptions, identifying risks, and coordinating with PS Operations, Legal, RevRec, GDC, Practices, and Governance to ensure every deal is clear, executable, and commercially sound before signature.
   

  

 Unleash Your Potential
   

  

 When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
 *be your best* 
 , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
 *do your best* 
 . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

title: Senior Customer Experience Manager

 **Kapture CX**

 **AI\-first Agentic Operating System for Enterprises** 
 .

 **AgentOS platform**

 **customer support, sales, collections, and claims** 
 .
   

  

 Kapture’s AI agents can execute workflows end\-to\-end across
 **voice, chat, email, messaging, and social channels** 
 , with human intervention built in wherever judgment, empathy, or decision\-making is required.
   

  

 Today, Kapture is trusted by
 **1,000\+ enterprises across 18 countries** 
 , helping organizations transform customer experience, automate complex workflows, and drive measurable business outcomes through
 **AI Agents, Agentic AI, Voice AI, Conversational AI, and intelligent automation** 
 .
   

  

**What is this role all about?**
 As a
 **Senior Customer Experience Manager**

 You will combine customer engagement, business understanding, technical expertise, and strong delivery capabilities to help customers achieve their objectives on Kapture. You will also identify opportunities for platform optimization, solutioning, and account growth while partnering closely with internal teams to resolve complex challenges and continuously improve the customer experience.

**Client Engagement**
* Own the overall health and success of a portfolio of enterprise customers, ensuring strong adoption, satisfaction, retention, and long\-term value.
* Build trusted relationships with business and technical stakeholders and act as a strategic advisor on customer objectives and platform usage.
* Lead QBRs, health checks, success planning, and key customer conversations to understand evolving needs and drive measurable outcomes.
* Proactively identify customer risks, address concerns, and build mitigation plans to strengthen customer relationships and renewal readiness.


**Project \& Delivery Management**
* Drive customer onboarding, implementation, integrations, and adoption initiatives, ensuring effective coordination across customers and internal teams.
* Manage multiple customer engagements and cross\-functional dependencies to ensure timely delivery and resolution of customer priorities.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Support teams to drive customer initiatives and ensure effective execution.


**Business Acumen**
* Understand customer business objectives and translate them into opportunities to improve platform adoption, utilization, and ROI.
* Analyze customer health, usage, feedback, and engagement trends to identify risks, improvement opportunities, and areas for growth.
* Identify expansion opportunities and partner with Customer Success and Sales teams to support account growth and long\-term customer value.
* Capture customer feedback and translate recurring needs and business challenges into actionable inputs for relevant internal teams.


**Technical Expertise**
* Understand the customer's technical architecture and integration setup well enough to have credible conversations with technical stakeholders.
* Maintain/contribute to troubleshooting guides, implementation docs, and RCAs. Owning the documentation of all projects involved in.
* Partner with Engineering/SRE to drive resolution of complex technical escalations, translating root cause into business impact and next steps for the customer.
* Own complex technical escalations by analyzing logs, debugging issues, andPartner with Engineering and Product teams to diagnose issues, drive resolution, and ensure effective communication with customers.


**Solutioning \& AI**
* Recommend platform configurations, workflows, integrations, and best practices that address customer requirements and improve business outcomes.
* Identify opportunities to leverage Kapture's automation and AI capabilities to improve customer experience, adoption, and operational efficiency.
* Work with Product and technical teams to translate customer requirements into scalable solutions and product improvements.
* Identify recurring customer challenges and contribute to scalable solutions rather than addressing issues individually.


**People Management**
* Mentor and support Customer Experience team members by sharing customer management, technical troubleshooting, and platform best practices.
* Support the team in managing complex customer situations and contribute to building stronger customer\-facing capabilities.


**What does success look like in this role?**
 Success in this role means
 **customers consistently realize measurable value from Kapture's platform, demonstrate strong adoption and engagement, and maintain healthy long\-term relationships with Kapture** 
 .
   

  

 You build trusted relationships across business and technical stakeholders, proactively resolve customer risks, deliver customer initiatives effectively, and use technical and business insights to improve customer outcomes. You also contribute to retention, account growth, and scalable solutions that improve the overall customer experience.
   

  

**What would make you a good fit for this role?**
**Basic Requirements**
* You have 5–7 years of experience in fast paced, complex, growth environments in Customer Success, Customer Experience, Technical Account Management, Solution Consulting, or Enterprise SaaS.
* You have experience managing enterprise customers across business and technical stakeholders.
* You have a strong understanding of customer lifecycle management, onboarding, adoption, retention, and stakeholder management.
* You have experience working with APIs, integrations, troubleshooting, and enterprise SaaS implementations.
* You have experience managing multiple Enterprise SaaS customer engagements in the geography and working cross\-functionally with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Support teams.
* You have strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to balance customer, business, and technical priorities.


**You Will Have An Advantage If You**

* Have experience with CRM platforms such as Salesforce or HubSpot.
* Have experience creating customer playbooks, implementation guides,dashboards, campaign management, troubleshooting documentation, and RCAs.
* Have experience identifying recurring customer issues and driving preventive or scalable solutions.
* Have experience identifying and supporting account expansion opportunities.
* Have experience with dashboarding, APIs, integration frameworks, SQL/NoSQL databases or data flows, tools such as Kafka, Grafana, or similar monitoring platforms.

title: Associate Value Engineer (Orbit- India)
description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.
   

  

**Role Description**
 As an Associate Value Engineer you are pushing the envelope in solving business\-critical problems for our customers. You are part of our Value Engineering team and are the trusted advisor for customers working on the intersection of technology and business. You will be working with our most strategic customers, understanding their objectives and key challenges, and building Celonis solutions using the world’s leading Process Intelligence (PI) platform in combination with the largest AI and ML technology partners, such as Microsoft, OpenAI and Databricks. With Celonis’ Process Intelligence (PI) platform we feed operational context to AI so it understands our customers’ business and enables them to industrialize AI unlocking real ROI on AI deployments and at scale. There is no AI without PI. You will prototype these solutions, demonstrate their value to Executives and ensure successful implementation, adoption and value realization in order to increase the footprint of Celonis at those customers.
   

  

**Launch Your Enterprise Software Career**
 Your journey will start with onboarding \& enablement to develop your business and Celonis skills through a combination of hands\-on experience in customer engagements and different pieces of training which cover amongst others the Celonis Process Intelligence, domain knowledge, presentation \& demo skills, discovery \& objection handling as well as value selling.
   

  

 Kickstart your career in enterprise software through our immersive 12\-month Orbit Program.
   

  

 During the program, you will be joining the Center of Excellence which is an international, diverse, and dynamic organization at the core of the Celonis Value Engineering team supporting our local field teams. As a team, we enjoy working in a fast\-paced environment and share a sense of belonging to an international community that wants to learn and grow together. The team culture is one based on building trust, continuous development, and improvement through coaching \& mentoring.
   

  

 This program offers a unique blend of client engagements, dedicated mentorship, and a strong team culture where collaboration and shared success are paramount. You'll leverage your technical background to develop essential skills, build lasting client relationships, and establish yourself as a trusted advisor, paving the way for significant career growth within Celonis.
   

  

 Your journey begins with comprehensive onboarding and enablement, followed by hands\-on experience in customer engagements and targeted training. You will gain expertise in:
   

  

* Discovery \& AI Solutioning
* Building and coding within the Celonis platform (SQL, PQL and Python)
* Scoping business and technical requirements
* Effectively handling objections
* Developing industry domain knowledge
* Delivering impactful presentations and demos
* Understanding value selling and realization
* Managing customer accounts


**What You'll Do:**
* AI Discovery \& Solutioning: Understand customers AI strategy and business critical challenges. As Celonis product \& domain expert, find the best problem\-solution fit and translate customer requirements into innovative solutions that move the needle
* Hackathons \& Prototyping: Think out of the box, have a “can\-do“ attitude and don’t shy away from complex problems. Leverage cutting edge AI technologies to rapidly build creative prototypes in customer hackathons solving business critical problems
* Agentic Process Transformation: Support our customers in achieving real ROI out of AI deployments at scale enabling a fundamental shift in business operations from traditional, rule\-based automation to the use of autonomous AI agents empowered by our Celonis Process Intelligence Platform
* Proof Projects: End\-to\-end execution of business\-critical Proof\-of\-Value projects showcasing the value of Celonis Process Intelligence tailored to customers and align our solutions with their AI strategy.
* Specialize in Domains or Industries: To scale knowledge across the organization specialize in domains (e.g. supply chain) and industries
* Business Impact Presentations: Articulate and quantify strategic business value for customers, delivering impactful presentations to senior executives to ensure successful value realization for customers.
* Ensure Successful Project Outcome: Applied AI Value Engineers stay involved with projects until agreed value \& adoption thresholds are reached
* Best Practice Modeling: Contribute to the Global Value Engineering Center of Excellence by creating reusable collateral, best practices, and tools.


**What You Need:**
* Degree in Engineering, Data Analytics/Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related STEM field.
* Excellent communication skills in English
* Extensive internship experience or 1\-2 years of full\-time work experience. Ideally at the intersection of business and technology.
* Excellent academic performance
* Understanding of generative AI techniques like RAG, few shot learning, prompt/context engineering, multi\-agent orchestration, multimodal understanding, or fine\-tuning that are used to build high\-impact use cases like intelligent chatbots and automated text processors.
* Good knowledge of Python and common ML libraries (such as LangChain, pandas, pydantic, sklearn, PyTorch) as well as data engineering tools and technologies.
* Excellent analytical and creative problem\-solving skills, with the ability to apply technology to business challenges.
* A customer\-centric mindset with a focus on delivering value.
* Confidence in presenting to diverse audiences.
* A proactive approach to problem\-solving, with a willingness to learn from mistakes.
* Curiosity, self\-motivation, a commitment to continuous learning, and the desire to thrive in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize and execute on deadlines.
* Foundational business acumen and domain understanding, e.g. in areas such as Supply Chain.


**Bonus Points:**
* Degrees combining technical (e.g., Computer Science, Data Science) and business (e.g., Economics, Marketing) skills.
* Customer\-facing, customer success/service, or sales experience.
* Hands\-on experience with technical Proof of Concept projects
* Hands\-on experience building agentic systems using LLM orchestration, RAG, function calling, and prompt engineering
* Working knowledge of tools in the LLM ecosystem such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or other OSS packages.
* Supply Chain process experience (Procurement, Order Management, Inventory Management, Production).
* Experience modeling ROI and TCO for business case justification.
* Experience with ERPs such as SAP and/or Oracle


 This a full time, unlimited position in our Bangalore office.
   

  

**What Celonis can offer you:**
* Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI\-driven business operations.
* Ownership from Day 1: Every full\-time Celonaut is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit\-based refresh grants.

* Work\-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
* Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70\-20\-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.

* Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
* Global Inclusion \& Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
* Value\-Driven Impact: Join a mission\-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.


**About Us:**
 Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI\-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry\-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.

And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard \- that's when creativity and innovation happen.

title: Strategy Analyst
description:

 Most internships have you fetching coffee or doing mindless data entry. This is not one of them. At Joveo, the Strategic Initiatives team operates like a startup within a scale\-up. We research, build, and scale new global supply channels and revenue streams from zero. We are looking for a

 If you are a first\-principle thinker who is relentlessly curious, highly analytical, and communicates exceptionally well, this is the place to accelerate your career.

 Conduct deep\-dive research into new markets, HR tech trends, and competitor landscapes to identify white\-space opportunities for Joveo.

 Audit our existing supply and partnership workflows. Find the bottlenecks, propose data\-backed solutions, and help build the Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to fix them.

 Work directly under the Chief Strategic Initiatives Officer and learn how to scale businesses from $0 to multi\-million dollar ARR.

 Your work will directly influence Joveo’s global expansion and bottom line.

 Get a crash course in B2B SaaS, Ad\-Tech, strategic partnerships, and global supply chains.

description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Manager, Tax Services** 
**– Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) \- SAP FICO/MM/SD integration with Direct or Indirect Tax experience**
 You will lead and support SAP\-enabled tax transformation efforts for US\-based clients, helping organizations improve the way tax integrates with enterprise processes and technology. As part of Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited, this role sits at the intersection of tax, ERP, and business transformation, with a focus on direct and indirect tax integration across SAP FICO, MM, and SD. You will work with client stakeholders, lead teams, and help deliver implementation\-driven solutions in a complex global tax environment.
   

  

**Work you'll do**
 As a Manager, Tax Services on the Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) team, you will be responsible for:
   

  

* Business Development: Develop and maintain contact with top decision makers at key clients; organize and lead pursuit teams; participate and lead aspects of the proposal development process; contribute to the development of proposal pricing strategies.
* Client Management: Manage the day\-to\-day interactions with executive clients and sponsors.
* Engagement Management: Lead engagement planning and budgeting; mobilize and manage engagement teams; define deliverable structure and content; facilitate buy\-in of proposed solutions from top management levels at the client; direct on\-time, quality delivery of work products; manage engagement economics; and manage engagement risk.
* Practice Development \& Eminence: Develop practical solutions and methodologies; develop "thought\-ware" and "point\-of\-view" documents; participate in public speaking events; get published in industry periodicals.
* People Development: Perform role of counselor and coach; provide input and guidance into the staffing process; actively participate in staff recruitment and retention activities; provide leadership and support for delivery teams and staff in local offices.


**The team**
 Deloitte’s Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) group helps our clients’ tax departments improve their operations by developing new technology\-enabled, cutting\-edge methods and processes. Deloitte TTC professionals are aligned across our global network of member firms to address our clients’ objectives in a seamless fashion. Deloitte TTC teams include industry, tax, organizational change, technology, and co\-sourcing specialists who help connect our clients’ global strategies and the options that exist to turn theory into an executable plan.
   

  

 TTC’s Enterprise Tax Integration (ETI) professionals provide an integrated approach to process improvement that can help the tax department maximize its strategic value to the organization. Companies that have already implemented or are considering implementing an enterprise resource planning (ERP) system often overlook the tax benefits these systems can provide or underestimate the impact on the tax department. To be most effective from a tax perspective, a successful ERP implementation requires professionals who specialize in tax and can effectively address a corporate tax function’s unique needs, requirements, and obligations. Our ETI team, the largest of its type, offers the necessary combination of skills, methodology and practical experience to help clients avoid the pitfalls of an ERP implementation.
   

  

 Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) \- Ever expanding regulations and increasing scrutiny on multinational corporations has made it necessary for leading\-edge tax departments to serve a critical role in the risk management and overall performance of the enterprise. This has resulted in an opportunity for Deloitte to provide even greater value through our tax services, in helping develop tax departments of the future that are strategic, agile, and, above all, focused on creating value for the business.
   

  

 Deloitte's TTC group helps our clients’ tax department move forward from their current state to the next generation of tax functions and is dedicated to finding new methods and processes to assist clients in improving their tax operations. Deloitte Tax LLP professionals are aligned worldwide to serve our clients’ needs through the TTC group. Deloitte TTC teams include industry, tax, organizational change, technology, and co\-sourcing specialists who can help make the necessary connections between our clients’ global strategies and the many options for carrying them out in the tax function.

 Required:
   

  

* 8 to 15\+ years of total experience.
* 5\+ years of Implementation experience in SAP ECC 6\.0 \& S4 HANA with focus on Tax integration with SAP FICO/MM/SD integration with direct or indirect tax experience.
* Experience with tax technology applications i.e., ONESOURCE /Global NEXT Integration, Vertex/Accelerator \& Chain flow Accelerator Integration, Avalara, Sovos.
* Expert in Direct and Indirect Tax configuration, Withholding Taxes, local country indirect tax localizations, VAT customizations and Reporting.
* Experience with User Exits, preparing functional specifications, executing test cycles, cutovers, go\-live and Hypercare, providing user training and documentation.
* Expert in cross functional integration of modules \- SD\-FI \& MM\-FI
* Strong analytical skills in business process design and requirements preparation


 Preferred:
   

  

* SAP MM or SD (ECC or S4 HANA) Certified
* SAP DRC, Central Finance with Tax integration, Transfer Pricing, BRIM
* Experience with New GL, Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, Intercompany, Materials Management, Logistics Invoice Verification, Asset Accounting implementation.
* Experience with Ariba, Coupa, Hybris, Open Text, Read soft Integration with ERP.


 \#SAPFICO\-TTC

Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. description:
Holiday Advisor

 This is a customer\-facing sales role. You do not need prior travel\-industry experience. We are looking for people with strong communication, patience, confidence, and the ability to understand a customer’s needs and guide them clearly.

 * Fresh graduate from any discipline.
* Excellent spoken communication skills.
* Comfortable speaking in English; Hindi or additional Indian languages are an advantage.
* Clear, confident and pleasant telephone manner.
* Good listening skills.
* Patient with customers who may need repeated explanations or help with technology.
* Ability to build rapport quickly.
* Comfortable discussing prices and helping customers make decisions.
* Strong customer\-service orientation.
* Positive attitude and willingness to learn.
* Basic computer and CRM comfort.
* Ability to follow up systematically and take ownership.
* Comfortable working in a target\-oriented environment without becoming overly aggressive in selling.


 The kind of person who will do well
 
 You may be a good fit if you naturally:
 


* enjoy talking to people,
* ask thoughtful questions,
* listen before answering,
* explain things simply,
* remain calm with demanding customers,
* remember details,
* follow through on what you promise,

 We are not looking for aggressive telecallers. We want people who can become
 **trusted travel advisors** 
 .

* Destinations and itineraries,
* ORN group journeys,
* travel pricing and inclusions,
* basic visa and travel processes,
* customer handling,
* consultative selling,
* objection handling,
* CRM and AI\-assisted sales tools,

 Role outcome
 
 Your success will be measured not only by bookings, but also by how well you:
 


* understand customers,
* communicate clearly,
* build trust,
* follow up consistently,
* move enquiries forward,
* and create a strong ORN customer experience.


 Ideal academic background
 
 Open to graduates from:
 


* BBA
* B.Com
* BA
* B.Sc
* BHM
* Travel \& Tourism
* Hospitality
* Mass Communication
* or any other graduate programme



 The degree matters less than
 **communication ability, confidence, attitude, and customer\-handling skills** 
 .
   




 Experience

title: Founding Key Account Manager
description:
**About Fabric** 




 Fabric is an AI hiring platform. Companies use our AI interviews, sourcing agents, and cheating detection to screen and hire at scale. We've run over 100,000 interviews for customers including Meesho, CRED, and Kearney.
 



 We're four founders who've known each other since college, building since early 2025\. Before Fabric, we ran a staffing business to $2M in annual revenue.
 



  





**The role** 




 Most of our revenue sits in our top 10\-12 accounts, and today the founders manage those relationships ourselves. You'll be our first account management hire. You'll take over the top of the book and grow it, and you'll build the playbook that every account hire after you will run.
 



 This is a founding role in the real sense: no team under you yet, no existing process, direct work with all four founders, and a real say in what we build.
 



  





**What you'll own** 



* The top 10\-12 customer accounts and the relationships with their TA and HR leadership
* Renewals and retention across your book. You should know an account is at risk 90 days before the renewal call
* Expansion: growing usage inside accounts and landing new teams and business units within existing customers
* QBRs, account plans, and the health signals that tell us which accounts need attention this week
* Customer feedback into product. You'll sit close enough to the founders that what you hear in accounts changes the roadmap



  





**What success looks like after 12 months** 



* Zero regretted churn in your book
* Your accounts have grown in usage and revenue against a number you carry
* Every key account has a live account plan and a QBR rhythm that actually happens
* Three or four of your accounts are referenceable: case studies, intros, references on sales calls



  





**You're probably a fit if** 



* You have 3\-6 years in account management or customer success at a B2B SaaS company, with a retention or expansion quota you can describe in numbers
* You've grown accounts yourself and can walk through exactly how, deal by deal
* You've operated without much support infrastructure and built your own process where none existed
* You can go deep on product. Our customers ask hard questions about how AI interviews and cheating detection work, and you'll need real answers

title: Founder's Team — Take Rate Specialist
description:
**Company Overview** 




 ITILITE is a leading global brand in Business Travel, Expense \& Card Management. We operate a B2B SaaS platform serving customers across the US and India, helping companies simplify travel and expense while making it an enjoyable experience for employees.
 



 We are Series C funded, having raised \~$50M from global Tier 1 investors including Tiger Global, Z47, Greenoaks, and Dharana Capital.
 



  





**Function:** 
 Revenue, Supplier Relations \& Commercial Strategy
 



**Level:** 
 Junior–Mid (1–2 years experience) \|
 



**Reports To:** 
 Founder / CXO
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a sharp, data\-driven and commercially minded professional to join our Founder's Team as a Take Rate Specialist. This is a high\-impact, high\-visibility role at the intersection of revenue analytics, supplier commissions, supplier relations and commercial strategy. You will work directly with the founding team to identify revenue leakage, optimize supplier commissions, strengthen supplier relationships and unlock new commercial opportunities across our supplier and partner ecosystem.
 



 This is not a back\-office role. You will be expected to get hands\-on with data, engage directly with suppliers, support and drive negotiations, solve commercial and operational issues, and make things happen.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 




  





**Revenue \& Supplier Commission Analysis** 



* Deep\-dive into historical spend patterns, financial reports, transaction data and supplier performance to identify where supplier commission revenue is being missed.
* Build and maintain dashboards and models that surface supplier commission trends, anomalies and optimization opportunities.
* Identify gaps in deal\-code application and commercial\-rule implementation; flag instances where the correct codes or terms are not being applied and work cross\-functionally to fix them.
* Analyze inventory utilization, supplier mix and underperforming categories or routes to identify
* opportunities for revenue and margin improvement.
* Benchmark supplier commissions against industry norms, competitive data and internal performance to identify opportunities to improve commercial outcomes.



  





**Supplier Relations \& Commercial Management** 



* Build and maintain strong working relationships with key suppliers and partners, acting as a commercial and analytical point of contact.
* Track supplier performance, commercial commitments, commission structures, rebates and other
* agreed terms to ensure delivery against expectations.
* Proactively identify supplier issues, revenue leakage, service gaps and commercial opportunities, and drive them to resolution.
* Maintain supplier performance scorecards and use data to identify suppliers that are performing well, require intervention or should be renegotiated or replaced.
* Work closely with internal teams and suppliers to improve content, inventory availability, pricing,
* commercial terms and overall supplier performance.



  





**Supplier Strategy and Negotiation** 



* Research and map potential new supplier and partner relationships that can deliver better commission structures, stronger economics or improved content and inventory.
* Prepare supplier proposals, comparison matrices, business cases and negotiation briefs to support commercial discussions.
* Lead or co\-lead supplier calls and negotiations, working to improve commission rates, rebate structures and other commercial terms.
* Support the founding team in evaluating supplier opportunities and making data\-backed commercial decisions.



  





**Insight \& Reporting** 



* Translate complex data findings into clear, concise recommendations for the founding team and relevant business stakeholders.
* Proactively flag revenue risks, supplier risks and commercial opportunities — do not wait to be asked.
* Prepare regular supplier commission and supplier performance reports, highlighting trends, issues, opportunities and actionable next steps.
* Develop concise executive\-level updates that make commercial performance easy to understand and act upon.



  





**Who You Are** 




  





**Must\-Have** 



* MBA and/or Engineering degree from a top\-tier college or university.
* 1–2 years of work experience in consulting, investment banking, fintech, e\-commerce, travel, revenue operations, commercial strategy or a high\-growth startup.
* Strong analytical mindset — you enjoy digging into numbers, spotting patterns and connecting dots others miss.
* Proficiency in Excel / Google Sheets; exposure to SQL or BI tools such as Tableau, Metabase or Looker is a strong plus.
* Excellent communication skills, including written, verbal and data storytelling.
* Comfortable interacting with suppliers and internal stakeholders and owning end\-to\-end tasks with minimal hand\-holding.
* High ownership mentality, bias for action and willingness to work hands\-on in a fast\-moving
* environment.



  





**Good to Have** 



* Prior exposure to revenue operations, supplier commission management, commercial finance or
* marketplace economics.
* Experience with supplier, vendor or partnership management.
* Familiarity with commission structures, rebates, commercial contracts or marketplace economics.
* Experience working with transaction\-level data or building commercial dashboards.
* Ability to juggle multiple workstreams without dropping the ball.



  





**What Success Looks Like** 



* Supplier commission leakage is identified quickly and reduced through data, process improvements and supplier action.
* Supplier relationships become more structured, proactive and commercially productive.
* Supplier performance and commercial terms are consistently tracked and improved.
* The founding team has clear, reliable visibility into supplier commission performance and commercial opportunities.
* New supplier opportunities are evaluated rigorously and converted into measurable revenue or margin improvement.



  





**Why Join** 



* Direct access to the founding team — your work will be seen, discussed and acted upon quickly.
* A steep learning curve across revenue, supplier relations, analytics, negotiations and commercial
* strategy.
* An opportunity to work directly with external suppliers while developing strong business and negotiation skills.
* A clear path to grow into a senior revenue, supplier strategy, commercial or business strategy role.
* The opportunity to make a measurable, visible impact on company revenue from day one.



  





**Candidates from top\-tier management institutions with a strong analytical foundation, commercial** 




**curiosity and the hunger to move fast are strongly encouraged to apply.**

title: ANALYST DATA & INSIGHTS III
description:
**At TE, you will unleash your potential working with people from diverse backgrounds and industries to create a safer, sustainable and more connected world.**
**Job Overview**
 We’re seeking \- a strategic thinker, analytical storyteller, and trusted advisor to our global marketing and commercial teams. This role is ideal for a seasoned analytics professional who combines technical depth with business acumen and has a proven ability to translate complex datasets into strategic insights that influence decisions and drive measurable growth.
   

  

 You will lead the end\-to\-end insights lifecycle \- from defining analytical requirements and shaping data strategy, to building analytical frameworks, crafting visualizations, and delivering compelling data narratives that guide business strategy. You will act as a key bridge between data, technology, and business, ensuring insights are not only accurate but also actionable and aligned to organizational priorities.
   

  

 In this role, you will work across marketing, sales, digital, and customer experience datasets to uncover performance drivers, identify growth opportunities, and forecast business outcomes. You’ll partner with other COE team members and translate raw data into stories that inspire confident decision\-making \- leveraging dashboards, deep\-dive analyses, and predictive models.
   

  

 You will also play a pivotal role in advancing the analytics maturity of the function \- partnering with data engineers, data insights partner, and marketers to improve data accessibility, enhance reporting efficiency, and embed a culture of data\-driven decision\-making. Familiarity with AI and machine learning applications will enable you to deliver predictive and prescriptive insights that accelerate TE’s digital and commercial transformation journey.
   

  

**Roles \& Responsibility**
* Strategic Insight \& Analytics: Partner with business insights partners and marketers to identify analytical opportunities and translate business challenges into measurable, data\-driven hypotheses. Provide strategic insights across campaign performance, sales funnel activity, digital engagement, and customer lifetime value. Lead complex analyses that connect the full buyer’s journey \- from awareness to conversion and retention
* Data Storytelling \& Visualization: Deliver compelling narratives and executive\-level dashboards using tools like Tableau, Power BI, Python and other tools to drive data accessibility and adoption.
* Advanced Analytics \& AI Integration: Apply advanced analytical techniques including predictive modeling, clustering, NLP, and A/B testing to optimize marketing and customer strategies. Partner with data engineers and other teams to scale insight capabilities using data lakes, cloud platforms, and machine learning frameworks.
* Insight Generation: Proactively uncover insights that go beyond descriptive analytics to inform strategic marketing and sales decisions. Strong ability to map and analyze the full Buyer’s Journey, connecting marketing metrics, lead funnel stages, and sales performance indicators (e.g., pipeline, conversion, revenue) to drive strategic insights and business impact. i.e \- Provide strategic insights across campaign performance, sales funnel activity, and web behavior.
* Performance Measurement \& Optimization: Quantify the impact of marketing and commercial initiatives on key KPIs \- including pipeline conversion, campaign ROI, customer acquisition, retention, and CLV. Conduct ad hoc and deep\-dive analyses to proactively uncover opportunities for optimization across digital, CRM, and sales channels.
* Collaboration \& Project Ownership: Collaborate cross\-functionally with marketing, data engineering, product, and commercial teams to deliver insight\-driven solutions on time and with measurable business value. title: Enterprise Client Partner
description:
**Location:** 
 Bengaluru
 



**Work mode:** 
 Remote
 



**Type:** 
 Full Time
 



**Experience:** 
 8–12 years
 



  





**Required skills:** 
 Enterprise Sales, Business Development, Client Partnership \& Account Management, IT / Engineering Services Sales, Account Growth \& Expansion, MSA \& Contract Negotiation, Enterprise Procurement \& Vendor Onboarding, RFP / RFI / Tender Response, Europe \& North America Markets, DACH Market, Business Reviews / QBRs, Pipeline \& Forecast Management, CRM GCC \& Build\-Operate\-Transfer Models.
 



  





 RemoteEngine designs, builds, and operates dedicated engineering teams for organizations in precision manufacturing, medical technology, and industrial software across Europe and North America. We are not a staffing intermediary; we own the recruiting, deployment, and retention of these teams, and our engineers stay embedded with clients for years rather than months. The company is privately held, self\-funded, and profitable.
 



  





 This role owns the full enterprise sales cycle: finding and qualifying target organizations, building relationships with engineering and technology leadership, navigating procurement and vendor onboarding, negotiating commercial terms, and growing each account into a substantial multi\-year relationship.
 



  





 It is a senior individual\-contributor appointment reporting directly to the founder and the first hire in a new commercial function. You will have genuine autonomy, including pricing authority within agreed margin parameters. Cycles in this market run six to twelve months, so the role needs patience for long pursuits alongside the discipline to expand the accounts we already hold.
 



  





**What you'll do** 



* Build and maintain a tiered list of approximately 50 named target accounts, mapping engineering, R\&D, technology, and procurement decision\-makers within each.
* Own the full enterprise sales cycle from first conversation to signed contract, including qualification, proposals, capability presentations, and responses to formal tenders and requests for proposals.
* Build multiple senior relationships inside each priority account rather than depending on a single sponsor.
* Grow existing enterprise clients through account plans with defined objectives for expansion into additional divisions, business units, and geographies.
* Chair quarterly business reviews with client stakeholders, presenting delivery performance, commercial outcomes, and forward proposals.
* Negotiate master service agreements, statements of work, rate structures, and commercial terms, working with the founder and external counsel as required.
* Manage vendor onboarding end to end, including supplier registration, security assessments, compliance documentation, and procurement approvals.
* Structure pricing to protect and improve gross margin, favor team\-based and outcome\-based models over per\-resource rate cards, and hold agreed margin thresholds on new business.
* Secure payment terms, rate escalation provisions, and contractual protections at the point of agreement.
* Forecast pipeline and revenue accurately, maintaining CRM discipline and reporting standards.
* Work closely with delivery and recruitment colleagues so that client satisfaction is sustained and commercial opportunities arising from delivery are identified early.
* Represent RemoteEngine at industry conferences and trade exhibitions, with responsibility for planning, meeting scheduling and follow\-up, and building a structured referral program across the client base.
* Establish the commercial processes and sales methodology through which the function will scale and support the recruitment and development of later commercial hires.



  





**What we're looking for** 



* A minimum of eight years' experience in business development, client partnership, or account management within IT services, engineering services, technology consulting, or a comparable B2B services environment.
* Demonstrable ownership of an individual revenue target, with a consistent record of achievement against it.
* Direct experience of selling to enterprise organizations, defined as businesses with annual revenues above €500 million or equivalent, with multi\-stage procurement processes.
* A verifiable record of growing at least one enterprise account substantially over time. You should be prepared to describe the account's progression, the specific actions you took, and the commercial outcome achieved.
* Experience managing sales cycles of six months or longer from first engagement to contract award.
* Experience selling into European or North American markets and working with client stakeholders across time zones and cultures.
* Direct experience negotiating master service agreements, statements of work, and rate structures with enterprise clients.
* Working knowledge of enterprise procurement processes, including vendor onboarding, supplier registration, security assessment, and compliance review.
* Demonstrable commercial judgement in structuring and defending pricing, including an understanding of gross margin and its drivers in a services business.
* Experience preparing and managing responses to formal tenders and requests for proposals.
* The ability to engage credibly with senior engineering and technology leadership on the substance of their work, not only on commercial matters.
* Excellent written and spoken English, to a standard appropriate for correspondence and presentation with senior European and North American stakeholders.
* Willingness to travel internationally several times a year, primarily within Europe, and to overlap with European business hours as required.
* Preferred: Experience selling into precision manufacturing, medical technology, semiconductor, industrial automation, or scientific instrumentation sectors.
* Preferred: Established relationships with engineering or technology leadership in these sectors within Europe.
* Preferred: Experience of the DACH market specifically and familiarity with how German and Swiss enterprises approach vendor selection.
* Preferred: Working knowledge of German or another European language.
* Preferred: Familiarity with global capability centers and build\-operate\-transfer engagement models.
* Preferred: A bachelor's degree in engineering, business, or a related discipline. A postgraduate management qualification is welcome but not required.

 Serves as the primary contact for and orchestrates customer engagements, strategically aligning resources (e.g., pod members, partners, v\-teams, cross\-functional teams). Proactively reaches out to and engages with customers through diverse digital channels (e.g., social selling, podcasts, webinars).
   

  

 Captures and synthesizes key learnings internally and externally about customers. Develops deep understanding of customer business and drives business discussions (e.g., ROI). Leverages digital tools to conduct comprehensive research on existing accounts and customers and identifies decision makers within the customer organization. Understands and relates customer business needs and priorities to Microsoft priorities and strategy. Demonstrates a strong understanding of the strategic customers' business strategy and the direction of appropriate industry(ies). Completes required training and certifications. title: Salesforce Architect
description:
**Req ID:** 
 387939
   

  

 NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward\-thinking organization, apply now.
   

  

 We are currently seeking a Salesforce Architect to join our team in Bangalore, Karnātaka (IN\-KA), India (IN).
   

  

 "Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Own end\-to\-end solution architecture across Agentforce, Salesforce CPQ and Revenue Cloud Advanced.
* Architect agent\-assisted and agentic workflows across opportunity, configuration, pricing, quoting, contracting, ordering and revenue lifecycle processes.
* Design agent orchestration patterns, including tool/function calling, workflow delegation, multi\-agent patterns, state management and memory.
* Architect integration of Agentforce with Salesforce automation, Apex, Flow, APIs, MuleSoft and external enterprise services.
* Define appropriate use of LLMs, deterministic logic, workflow engines and traditional automation, rather than defaulting all use cases to generative AI.
* Design context engineering and retrieval strategies, including structured/unstructured grounding, retrieval depth, metadata filtering and relevance optimization.
* Establish secure agent action patterns using least\-privilege access, guardrails, validation, approval checkpoints and human\-in\-the\-loop mechanisms.
* Define AI evaluation frameworks covering answer quality, grounding, hallucination, task completion, tool selection, latency and business outcomes.
* Establish observability across agent reasoning paths, actions, integration failures, token/credit consumption and operational performance.
* Assess model and platform trade\-offs across quality, latency, context window, cost, privacy and enterprise constraints.
* Architect resilient action layers and transactional integration patterns for revenue processes where consistency and recoverability are critical.
* Advise programs on consumption\-based economics, AI credit/token optimization and architectural approaches to control run\-time cost.
* Lead architecture reviews, design authorities and technical governance across global delivery teams.
* Mentor technical architects, developers and Agentforce specialists.


 Required Technical Expertise
   

  

* Salesforce Agentforce and associated agentic architecture concepts.
* Salesforce CPQ and Revenue Cloud Advanced / Revenue Lifecycle Management.
* Salesforce Sales Cloud and core platform architecture.
* Agent orchestration and tool/function calling.
* Multi\-agent architectures, delegation and coordination patterns.
* Agent state, short/long\-term memory and session/context management.
* MCP and agent\-to\-agent interoperability concepts/patterns.
* RAG, semantic/vector search, embeddings, chunking and retrieval optimization.
* Context engineering beyond basic prompt engineering.
* Evaluation frameworks and AI observability.
* AI safety, grounding, guardrails and least\-privilege action design.
* LLM model selection and architectural trade\-offs.
* Classic NLP concepts including intent classification, entity extraction, semantic similarity and ranking.
* Apex, Lightning Platform, Flow, APIs and enterprise integration patterns.
* Strong understanding of asynchronous processing, transaction boundaries, resiliency, retries and idempotency.
* Security architecture including sharing, CRUD/FLS, permission models and data protection.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 15\+ years overall technology experience; 10\+ years in Salesforce CPQ / Revenue Cloud architecture.
* Proven experience architecting enterprise CPQ / Quote\-to\-Cash implementations.
* Salesforce Application/System/Technical Architect credentials strongly preferred.
* Agentforce and Revenue Cloud\-related certifications or demonstrable implementation experience.
* Experience with MuleSoft and large enterprise integration landscapes preferred.
* Ability to communicate architectural decisions to both engineering teams and senior business stakeholders."

title: Associate - Supply Operations
description:
**Associate — Global Strategic Partnerships** 




 You don't just "manage" partners. You build the supply engine that powers a global AI platform.
 



 Joveo's recruitment advertising platform runs on machine learning, real\-time bidding, and predictive optimization — delivering millions of job ads to the right candidates at the right moment. But none of that works without world\-class supply partnerships fueling the machine.
 



 That's where you come in.
 



  





**The Role — In Plain English** 




 You'll own relationships that directly impact revenue, reach, and platform performance across global markets.
 



 This isn't account management with a fancier title. You're the person who spots an untapped supply channel in Southeast Asia on Tuesday, negotiates the commercial terms by Thursday, and has it live and delivering candidates the following week.
 



 Your week might look like this:
 


* **Monday:** 
 Analyze partner performance data. One channel is underpacing — you diagnose why and fix it before anyone escalates.
* **Tuesday:** 
 Jump on a call with a new publisher. Pitch the partnership. Negotiate terms that work for both sides.
* **Wednesday:** 
 Sit with Product and Tech to unblock an integration that's been stalling a high\-value partner launch.
* **Thursday:** 
 Build an automation workflow that eliminates 4 hours of manual reporting your team does every week.
* **Friday:** 
 Present your partner growth roadmap to the CXO. Get buy\-in. Start executing.



 You'll talk to partners in the morning, negotiate contracts before lunch, dig into performance dashboards after, and pitch process improvements to leadership by end of day — all in the same role.
 



  





**What Makes This Different** 




 Most partnership roles at this level put you in a box — either "relationship manager" or "operations associate." This one refuses to separate the two.
 



 You'll own the full lifecycle: find the partner, close the deal, launch the integration, track the numbers, optimize the outcome. End to end. No handoffs to five other teams.

title: Solutions Engineer
description:
**Solution Engineer I/ II** 




**1\-4 years Experience** 




  





 We at Setu are looking for those who share our core belief \- “Every Day is Game Day”. We bring our best selves to work each day to realize our mission of enriching the world through the power of digital commerce and financial services.
 



  





**Importance of the role** 




 At Setu, we believe that every company can become a fintech company. Any tech\-enabled business that wants to offer or build financial products will rely on Setu APIs. To achieve this goal, we need engineers who are ready to tackle the challenges at the intersection of Setu’s products and customers’ requirements, engage in meaningful technical discussions, and help our customers
 



 thrive. Our success as a company is directly tied to our customers' success. Most importantly, we
 



 need you to be empathetic, understanding that many of our customers may not be tech\-savvy due
 



 to their roots in traditional institutions.
 



  





**What will you do at Setu?** 




 You will work on the Solutions Engineering Team and primarily help our customers with
 



 consuming Setu’s Products. Below are some of the responsibilities that we expect you to
 



 take up.
 



 ● Architecting — Figuring out all levels of designing and structuring systems,
 



 deciding on optimal levels of abstraction and future\-proofing, patterns of
 



 orchestration of components and finally planning its execution.
 



 ● Implementation — Should be able to structure and write code like pros for others to read,
 



 design, and adhere to common principles and patterns that make everyone better at
 



 their jobs. Should be able to contribute according to timelines and type of projects —
 



 from working with POCs to stabilize the production code and the ability to work with a
 



 large breadth of knowledge.
 



 ● Orchestration and integration — Interact with the larger engineering team to integrate
 



 your work into the ecosystem, help others in building over the base that you provide, and
 



 help in orchestrating your work into CI/CD, testing, QA, and automation pipelines.
 



 ● Mentorship — We all love to learn and grow as engineers and human beings. We believe
 



 in synchronous growth as a team fueled by every individual's abilities, specializations,
 



 and interests. To enable this, you'll be required to mentor others by sharing your
 



 expertise in various forms and be subject to being mentored by others and thus maintain
 



 a continuous learning culture.
 



 ● Ownership — End\-to\-end ownership of services and specialized components required for
 



 various projects \- starting from the prototypal stage to production\-hardened.
 



 ● Documentation — Create well\-crafted technical content, and architecture diagrams,
 



 including samples, and training.
 



 Below is what your day\-to\-day responsibilities would look like,
 



 ● Engage with customers through calls to understand their requirements and assist
 



 them in effectively using our products. (In\-person visit to their office if needed)
 



 ● Support billers in onboarding to the Bharat Connect (formerly BBPS) platform by
 



 managing technical integrations between Biller APIs and Setu infrastructure.
 



 ● Develop, maintain, and enhance existing frameworks and systems while building
 



 new ones as needed.
 



 ● Create quick prototypes or proof\-of\-concept projects for new features or
 



 initiatives.
 



 ● Develop tailored solutions for customers when their needs extend beyond the
 



 standard product scope.
 



  





**Who is the right fit for this role?** 




 To excel in this role you will need—
 



 ● Empathy: We operate with a profoundly consultative approach. Asking relevant questions
 



 to understand customers' needs and motivations is critical.
 



 ● Strong organizational skills: As part of the role, you will need to be on top of multiple
 



 threads between different internal and external stakeholders.
 



 ● Strong written and oral communication skills with a keen analytical mind. You will also
 



 need to break down complex scenarios to make recommendations.
 



 ● Familiarity with our tech stack helps,
 



 ○ Backend: Python3, Flask / FastAPI, OpenAPI, golang (optional)
 



 ○ DB: SQL, AWS Dynamo DB
 



 ○ Infrastructure: AWS (Lambda, ECS), Terraform
 



 ● A burning desire to learn and develop deep fintech expertise.
 



  





**Why Setu?** 




 We will spare no efforts to ensure that Setu empowers you to do the most important and impactful
 



 work of your career—
 



 ● Opportunity to work closely with the founding team who built and scaled public
 



 infrastructure such as UPI, GST, Aadhaar, etc.
 



 ● We care deeply about your growth. So we work hard to provide you with—
 



 ○ A fully stocked library and unlimited book budget.
 



 ○ Tickets to conferences and industry events.
 



 ○ Learning sessions where we invite both team members and external experts to
 



 teach you something new.
 



 ○ Learning and development allowance that gives access to subscriptions, courses,
 



 certifications, music classes, and much more. Grow, learn, and improve with Setu!
 



 ● Kick\-ass benefits including comprehensive health insurance for you and your family,
 



 personal accident and term life insurance, access to mental health counsellors,
 



 extraordinary coffee, and a beautiful office with lots of solid wood and natural light.
 



 ● We work hard to make sure our team is diverse and varied. We interview and hire purely
 



 on merit, skill, and competence—everything else is irrelevant.
 



  





**Our core DNA** 




 Our culture code—How We Move, defines the behaviours we expect from our people. When you
 



 display any of the six culture code elements, you demonstrate ‘Every Day is Game Day’. The six
 



 elements of our culture code—
 



 ● Take the shot: You decide fast and deliver right.
 



 ● Sign your work like an artist: You master what you do and take pride in it.
 



 ● Be the sherpa: You lead your crew on every expedition.
 



 ● Be the CEO of what you do: You own it and make things happen.
 



 ● Care with tough love: You empower others with trust, respect, and openness.
 



 ● Own tomorrow: You innovate for the customer and beyond.
 



 Join us if you want to be part of a company that’s building infrastructure that will directly impact
 



 financial inclusion and improve millions of lives. No cashbacks, no growth\-hacks, no gimmicks. Just
 



 an audacious mission, and an obsession with craftsmanship in code.

 This role will be hugely rewarding for individuals who have a competitive streak and like to

 UK\&I’s work winning pipeline working on some of the largest and most exciting tenders in the
   

  

 market.
   

  

**Responsibilities**

 responsibility:

* Review tender documents and develop appropriate pricing strategies to deliver high quality and competitive tender submissions.
* Manage pricing inputs (mainly Pricing Models) and ensure these are appropriately completed to enable commercial decisions to be made.
